jobs.title: Compliance Associate
jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 225 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Lombard Odier Investment Managers (“LOIM”) is the asset management business of the Lombard Odier Group. In order to strengthen our Compliance Team, we are looking for a Luxembourg based:

Compliance Associate

YOUR ROLE

• Act as a key point of contact for compliance and AML (Anti-Money Laundering) matters within the organization.

• Support the implementation and ongoing enhancement of the compliance monitoring program, ensuring alignment with Luxembourg regulatory requirements (CSSF, AML/CFT, MiFID II, UCITS, AIFMD, etc.).

• Coordinate the migration of manual Compliance and AML processes (e.g., Excel-based) into automated Alteryx workflows and Tableau dashboards, driving digital transformation within the team.

• Collaborate with IT, business units, and other Compliance/AML team members to design and implement data-driven solutions that support decision-making and business tracking.

• Conduct compliance risk assessments, gap analyses, and thematic reviews.

• Monitor regulatory developments and assess their impact on business activities; ensure timely communication and implementation of new requirements.

• Draft, review, and update compliance policies, procedures, and internal controls.

• Support and coordinate regulatory reporting, internal/external audits, and respond to regulatory inquiries.

YOUR PROFILE

• University degree in Law, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field; additional compliance certifications (e.g., CAMS, ICA, or equivalent) are a strong asset.

• Relevant experience (up to 3 years) in a compliance, AML, or risk management role within the asset management or financial services industry, ideally in Luxembourg.

• Knowledge of Luxembourg and EU regulatory frameworks (CSSF, AML/CFT, MiFID II, UCITS, AIFMD, FATCA/CRS, etc.).

• Experience with Business Intelligence platforms (Tableau, Alteryx) and a strong interest in process automation and data analytics.

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills; ability to manage mu

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer (80-100%)
jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 225 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Site Reliability Engineer (80-100%)

As part of the modernization of our IT platform, we are looking for a Platform-oriented Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) who can support us in increasing our maturity around containers and the related ecosystem.

YOUR ROLE

• Ensure the reliability, scalability, and performance of the OpenShift platform and its ecosystem (Kong, Kafka, Vault).

• Manage the platform lifecycle: provisioning, updates, patching, and capacity planning.

• Implement and maintain observability solutions (metrics, logs, tracing) using Prometheus, Grafana, and associated tools.

• Establish governance for observability and operability of applications hosted on the platform.

• Handle incident response and perform root cause analysis for platform-related issues.

• Collaborate with security teams to apply best practices and ensure compliance in containerized environments.

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of the platform architecture and operational processes.

• Internal contacts : Databases, Systems, Telecom, Citrix, Development, Service Management (Incidents and Problems), Integration.

YOUR PROFILE

• Higher education in Computer Science (master’s degree or equivalent).

• 5 to 10 years of experience in a similar role

• Excellent command of OpenShift and/or Kubernetes administration

• Excellent command of monitoring and alerting systems (Prometheus, Grafana) and overall operational maintenance

• Excellent command of Linux (RHEL/CentOS)

• Excellent command of scripting (Shell, Python)

• Knowledge networking, security, and RBAC concepts in containerized environments

• Knowledge of high availability and disaster recovery strategies

• Responsible, rigorous, versatile, flexible, and with strong interpersonal skills. Team player, continuous improvement mindset, proactive

• Fluent in French and English

• Resident in Switzerland or willing to relocate

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote a diverse and inclusive work environment for our employees and candidates. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are woven into the fabric of our Maison’s DNA, and we strive to ensure that our employees can fulfill both their personal and professional aspirations by encouraging internal mobility and individual upskilling programs. We firmly believe that building Diverse Teams contributes to our successes and to deliver on this, we actively embed Diversity, Equity and Inclusion in our business strategy.

It is an exciting time to join our Teams. All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Una carriera a Lombard Odier significa lavorare per un rinomato asset manager globale, con un forte focus sugli investimenti sostenibili. Un'innovativa banca di scelta per clienti privati e istituzionali, il nostro Studio indipendente di proprietà è uno dei gruppi bancari più capitalizzati al mondo, che gestisce quasi 300 miliardi di franchi e opera da oltre 25 uffici in 4 continenti. Con una storia di oltre 225 anni, Lombard Odier è una casa di investimento che offre un'offerta completa di gestione del portafoglio discrezionale e consultivo, servizi di ricchezza e custodia. Offriamo anche servizi di asset management e strategie di investimento attraverso Lombard Odier Investment Manager e fornire tecnologia bancaria avanzata ad altre istituzioni finanziarie. “Rethink Everything” è la nostra filosofia – è al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo. Siamo cresciuti più forti attraverso più di 40 crisi finanziarie ripensando il mondo intorno a noi per fornire una nuova prospettiva di investimento per i nostri clienti. Ingegnere di affidabilità del sito (80-100%) Nell'ambito della modernizzazione della nostra piattaforma IT, siamo alla ricerca di un Ingegnere di Affidabilità del Sito (SRE) orientato alla Piattaforma che possa supportarci nell'aumentare la nostra maturità intorno ai container e all'ecosistema relativo. Il tuo!
• Assicurare l'affidabilità, la scalabilità e le prestazioni della piattaforma OpenShift e del suo ecosistema (Kong, Kafka, Vault).
• Gestire il ciclo di vita della piattaforma: fornitura, aggiornamenti, patch e pianificazione della capacità.
• Implementare e mantenere le soluzioni di osservabilità (metriche, registri, tracciamento) utilizzando Prometheus, Grafana e strumenti associati.
• Stabilire la governance per l'osservanza e l'operabilità delle applicazioni ospitate sulla piattaforma.
• Mantenere la risposta agli incidenti e eseguire l'analisi delle cause root per problemi legati alla piattaforma.
• Collaborare con i team di sicurezza per applicare le migliori pratiche e garantire la conformità in ambienti containerizzati.
• Contribuire al miglioramento continuo dell'architettura della piattaforma e dei processi operativi.
• Contatti interni: Database, Sistemi, Telecom, Citrix, Development, Service Management (Incidenti e Problemi), Integrazione. Il tuo progetto
• Istruzione superiore in Informatica (grado del maestro o equivalente).
• da 5 a 10 anni di esperienza in un ruolo simile
• Ottimo comando dell'amministrazione OpenShift e/o Kubernetes
• Comando eccellente dei sistemi di monitoraggio e allerta (Prometheus, Grafana) e manutenzione operativa complessiva
• Ottimo comando di Linux (RHEL/CentOS)
• Ottimo comando di scripting (Shell, Python)
• Rete di conoscenza, sicurezza e concetti RBAC in ambienti containerizzati
• Conoscenza delle strategie di alta disponibilità e di disaster recovery
• Responsabile, rigoroso, versatile, flessibile e con forti competenze interpersonali. Giocatore di squadra, mindset di miglioramento continuo, proattivo
• Fluente in francese e inglese
• Residente in Svizzera o disposto a trasferirsi Il DNA della nostra Maison è definito da cinque valori fondamentali. L'eccellenza ci spinge ad essere i migliori a quello che facciamo, mentre l'innovazione alimenta i nostri progressi. Il rispetto sostiene ogni interazione, e l'integrità plasma le nostre azioni. Insieme, siamo un team unico, uniti nel servire i nostri clienti con dedizione inaspettata. Come datore di lavoro responsabile e di supporto, promuoviamo un ambiente di lavoro diversificato e inclusivo per i nostri dipendenti e candidati. Diversità, equità e inclusione sono intrecciati nel tessuto del DNA della nostra Maison, e ci sforziamo di garantire che i nostri dipendenti possano soddisfare sia le loro aspirazioni personali che professionali incoraggiando la mobilità interna e programmi di upskilling individuali. Crediamo fermamente che la costruzione di Diverse Teams contribuisca ai nostri successi e a fornire su questo, abbiamo attivamente incorporato Diversità, Equità e Inclusione nella nostra strategia aziendale. E' un momento emozionante per unirsi ai nostri team. Tutte le applicazioni saranno gestite nella massima fiducia.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Eine Karriere bei Lombard Odier bedeutet, für einen renommierten globalen Vermögens- und Vermögensverwalter mit einem starken Fokus auf nachhaltige Investitionen zu arbeiten. Eine innovative Bank der Wahl für private und institutionelle Kunden, unser unabhängiger Eigentümer Firm ist eine der besten Bankengruppen der Welt, die in der Nähe von CHF 300 Milliarden verwaltet und von über 25 Büros auf 4 Kontinenten. Lombard Odier ist mit einer über 225 Jahre langen Geschichte ein Investmenthaus, das ein umfassendes Angebot an diskreten und beratenden Portfolio-Management, Vermögensdienstleistungen und Sorge bietet. Wir bieten auch Asset-Management-Dienste und Anlagestrategien durch Lombard Odier Investment Manager und bieten fortschrittliche Banktechnologie an andere Finanzinstitute. „Rethink Everything“ ist unsere Philosophie – es liegt im Herzen von allem, was wir tun. Wir sind durch mehr als 40 Finanzkrisen stärker gewachsen, indem wir die Welt um uns herum neu denken, um unseren Kunden eine neue Investitionsperspektive zu bieten. Site Reliability Engineer (80-100%) Im Rahmen der Modernisierung unserer IT-Plattform suchen wir einen plattformorientierten Site Reliability Engineer (SRE), der uns bei der Steigerung unserer Reife um Container und das damit verbundene Ökosystem unterstützen kann. IHRE ROLLE
• Gewährleistung der Zuverlässigkeit, Skalierbarkeit und Leistung der OpenShift-Plattform und ihres Ökosystems (Kong, Kafka, Vault).
• Verwalten des Plattform-Lebenszyklus: Bereitstellung, Updates, Patching und Kapazitätsplanung.
• Beobachtbarkeitslösungen (Metriken, Protokolle, Tracing) mit Prometheus, Grafana und zugehörigen Werkzeugen implementieren und pflegen.
• Stellen Sie Governance für die Einhaltung und Funktionsfähigkeit von auf der Plattform gehosteten Anwendungen fest.
• Handle-Crash-Antwort und führen Wurzel verursachen Analyse für plattformbezogene Probleme.
• Mit Sicherheitsteams zusammenarbeiten, um Best Practices anzuwenden und die Einhaltung in containerizzato Umgebungen zu gewährleisten.
• Beitrag zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Plattformarchitektur und der operativen Prozesse.
• Interne Kontakte: Datenbanken, Systeme, Telecom, Citrix, Entwicklung, Service Management (Einfälle und Probleme), Integration. IHRE PROFILE
• Hochschulbildung in Informatik (Master-Abschluss oder gleichwertig).
• 5 bis 10 Jahre Erfahrung in einer ähnlichen Rolle
• Ausgezeichneter Befehl von OpenShift und/oder Kubernetes Administration
• Hervorragender Befehl der Überwachungs- und Warnsysteme (Prometheus, Grafana) und der gesamten betrieblichen Wartung
• Ausgezeichneter Befehl von Linux (RHEL/CentOS)
• Hervorragender Befehl des Skripts (Shell, Python)
• Wissensvernetzungs-, Sicherheits- und RBAC-Konzepte in Containerumgebungen
• Wissen über hohe Verfügbarkeit und Katastrophenrückgewinnungsstrategien
• Verantwortungsvoll, streng, vielseitig, flexibel und mit starken zwischenmenschlichen Fähigkeiten. Teamplayer, kontinuierliche Verbesserung Mindset, proaktiv
• Fluent auf Französisch und Englisch
• Wohnsitz in der Schweiz oder bereit, sich zu verlagern Die DNA unseres Hauses wird durch fünf Kernwerte definiert. Exzellenz treibt uns dazu, das Beste zu sein, während Innovation unseren Fortschritt vorantreibt. Respekt unterstützt jede Interaktion und Integrität prägt unsere Handlungen. Gemeinsam sind wir ein Team, vereint in der Betreuung unserer Kunden mit unerschütterlicher Hingabe. jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 225 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Lombard Odier Investment Managers (“LOIM”) is the asset management business of the Lombard Odier Group. In order to strengthen our Private Assets department, we are looking for a Geneva based:

Investment Analyst- Private Assets

As an Investment Analyst, you will work closely with Investment Managers and broader team members across all stages of the private equity investment cycle, contributing to the sourcing, assessment, and monitoring of private asset opportunities

YOUR ROLE

• Maintain and update the private assets fund opportunity pipeline

• Analyse new private equity fund investments, co‑investments/directs, industry trends, and market dynamics

• Perform detailed due diligence on investment opportunities, including qualitative and quantitative analysis

• Prepare investment memoranda, due diligence documentation, and internal committee materials

• Monitor and report on existing fund investments, providing in‑depth performance insights

• Support the preparation of marketing materials for LOIM private equity strategies and products

• Develop sales pitches, presentations, and other materials for internal and external stakeholders

YOUR PROFILE

• Master’s degree, ideally in business, economics, finance, or engineering

• Prior professional experience in Private Equity, Corporate Finance, or Investment Banking is essential

• Native-level proficiency in English; professional working proficiency in French

• Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, with excellent attention to detail

• Proactive, innovative, and results‑driven mindset

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities

• Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote a diverse and inclusive work environment for our employees and candidates. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are woven into the fabric of our Maison’s DNA, and we strive to ensure that our employees can fulfill both their personal and professional aspirations by encouraging internal mobility and individual upskilling programs. We firmly believe that building Diverse Teams contributes to our successes and to deliver on this, we actively embed Diversity, Equity and Inclusion in our business strategy.

It is an exciting time to join our Teams. All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence.

Développeur Full-stack IA/ML & Reporting Designer

Rejoignez le département Technology & Operations de Lombard Odier au sein de l'équipe Content and Communications, responsable de la plateforme de gestion de contenu et de la production/distribution des documents clients et partenaires.

Nous recherchons un développeur Full-stack IA/ML et Reporting Designer afin de participer au développement de notre nouvelle plateforme technologique bancaire qui est également mise à disposition d’autres banques privées suisses et européennes.

Intégré(e) aux équipes produits, vous apporterez une expertise à l’intersection des LLM et de l’ingénierie logicielle appliquées à la finance : recherche documentaire augmentée (RAG), orchestration et optimisation d’inférence (on‑prem/cloud), intégration des modèles dans les parcours front‑office, et automatisation du reporting en production. Vous industrialiserez la génération et la personnalisation des documents via la suite Quadient Inspire (templates, composants, workflows et publication), en garantissant la qualité, la traçabilité et l’auditabilité de bout en bout. Vous évoluerez au sein d’une organisation agile, proche des utilisateurs finaux et du métier, au contact de technologies modernes et éprouvées.

VOTRE MISSION

• Contribuer aux développements de nos applications de gestion de contenu et de la production/distribution des documents.

• Comprendre les besoins des utilisateurs, les problèmes à résoudre ainsi que les contraintes d’ordre technique.

• Proposer et implémenter des solutions technologiques adaptées et tenant compte des aspects précités.

VOTRE PROFIL

• Master en informatique avec spécialisation en IA, Machine Learning et Data analytics suivi dans l'une des universités polytechnique suisse.

• Première expérience professionnelle ou stage significatif dans le développement applicatif, le reporting ou les outils documentaires.

• Computer Vision : Maîtrise des LLM/VLM appliqués aux documents (RAG, extraction visuelle, compréhension de mise en page).

• Expérience en détection d’anomalies documentaires (contrôles visuels, cohérence sémantique, règles métier).

• Maîtrise des langages de programmation Java et Python

• Expérience en LLM engineering : fine‑tuning, quantization, RAG (LangChain/LangGraph), et orchestration (LlamaIndex).

• Connaissance du framework de développement d’application web Angular

• Expérience conteneurs (Dockers / Kubernetes) et DevOps

• Expérience pratique des méthodologies Agile, Scrum est un plus

• Maîtrise courante du français et de l’anglais

• Vous avez une excellente communication à l’écrit comme à l’oral

• Vous avez un bon esprit d’analyse et une bonne capacité d'abstraction afin d’identifier et expliciter le problème à résoudre avant de penser aux solutions

• Vous êtes capable de donner du feedback constructif et prêt à en recevoir

• Vous faites preuve d’une grande autonomie

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. Product Owner – Risk & Compliance (CRM Platform)

Lombard Odier Group operates its own proprietary banking technology platform used by the Group and provided to other private banks and financial institutions through a BPO business model. The Technology & Operations (T&O) department maintains and develops the platform through the delivery of solutions for the Bank’s business divisions.

Within Lombard Odier’s Development department, we seek to strengthen our teams with an experienced Product Owner dedicated to the Risk & Compliance domain within our Customer Relationship Management (CRM) product. Our bankers’ CRM—primarily developed in-house—is fully integrated within our Wealth Management application suite and is a key differentiator of our technology offering. Given the central role of client lifecycle management and first-line controls in Private Banking, we aim to bring our CRM’s Risk & Compliance capabilities to the next level.

As a Product Owner for Risk & Compliance within the CRM platform, you will be part of the Wealth Management software development team and report to the CRM Product Manager. The team, working in an agile framework, brings together all “front-office” products serving bankers, relationship managers, clients, and key control functions. In your day-to-day work, you will collaborate with peer product owners, product managers, project managers, business analysts, developers, and—crucially—business stakeholders across Private Clients, Group Compliance & Risk, Tax, and Regulatory Reporting.

YOUR ROLE

• Define the product vision and roadmap for Risk & Compliance in CRM

• Own the end-to-end design and evolution of AML/KYC risk scoring within CRM

• Implement and streamline regulatory suitability & appropriateness processes

• Act as the primary interface between business stakeholders and the product team, ensuring clear understanding, timely feedback loops, and resolution of emerging needs and issues.

• Perform continuous market and regulatory watch on compliance tooling and operating practices (e.g., KYC/CLM, suitability, AML risk engines) to benchmark and anticipate changes.

• Proactively work with our 3rd party suppliers to drive value, establishing a solid and sound relationship.

• Lead potential RFI/RFP processes

• Foster a positive product team dynamic while maximizing ROI of product features as well as end users’ satisfaction.

Ce rôle consiste à fournir un soutien technique, à résoudre les problèmes et à collaborer avec diverses équipes pour maintenir un environnement d'application bancaire fiable. Il est chargé de fournir aux collaborateurs et clients du groupe Lombard Odier des applications de support fonctionnel dans le domaine Finance. • Analyse du bilan dans SAP.
• Assurer une formation de qualité aux utilisateurs des banques.
• Participer à de nouveaux tests de libération d'applications.
• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de développement et de production.
• Assurer un contact régulier avec nos partenaires de la Banque.
• Contribuer activement à améliorer le processus quotidien de l'équipe en proposant des améliorations au chef de l'appui à l'application VOTRE PROFIL
• Maîtrise en informatique ou finance
• +5 ans d'expérience en banque
• Excellente communication et compétences générales, proactivité, sens de l'initiative et bonne expérience dans le travail sous stress sur des sujets non planifiés
• Excellente maîtrise des opérations bancaires et financières et compréhension des principes comptables
• Bonne commande des outils Microsoft Office, en particulier Excel & PowerPoint
• L'expérience antérieure en tant qu'analyste d'entreprise ou vérificateur dans le secteur bancaire et financier est un avantage
• La connaissance SAP BI est un avantage

Ensemble, nous sommes une équipe, unie pour servir nos clients avec un dévouement inébranlable. En tant qu'employeur responsable et solidaire, nous favorisons un milieu de travail diversifié et inclusif pour nos employés et nos candidats. Diversité, équité et inclusion sont tissés dans le tissu de notre ADN Maison, et nous nous efforçons de faire en sorte que nos employés puissent réaliser leurs aspirations personnelles et professionnelles en encourageant la mobilité interne et les programmes de perfectionnement individuel. Nous croyons fermement que la création d'équipes diversifiées contribue à nos succès et pour y parvenir, nous intégrons activement la diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion dans notre stratégie d'affaires. C'est un moment passionnant de rejoindre notre Te

jobs.title: Business Support Intern
jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Business Support Intern

Integrated to the Management Committee of Lombard Odier T&O Service (Europe) SA, as a Business Support Intern, you will gain hands-on experience in corporate governance and administrative support for executive leadership. This internship will provide exposure to legal frameworks, risk management, and decision-making processes within a corporate environment. Working closely with experienced professionals, you will develop essential skills in organization, communication, and confidentiality.

YOUR ROLE
- Coordination and preparation of presentation materials for the Management Committee (Townhall, ExCo, etc)
- Drafting & circulation of meeting minutes
- Preparation of Reporting such as Reg Reporting
- Management of common mailbox,
- Coordination of internal (sport committee, etc) & external events
- Procedures/Policies Management :

• Coordination with their respective managers regarding deadlines for updating procedures

• Coordination of the formal validation process

• · Management of publications on the Intranet and communication with LOT&OS Employees

YOUR PROFILE
As the sole person in this role, you will benefit from significant autonomy and the following qualities will be expected :
- Strong organizational and anticipation skills,
- Adaptibility,
- Strong interpersonal and diplomatic skills,
- High level of confidentiality,
- Strong writing skills in French and English
- Very good command of Words and Office package.

NB: Please be aware that in accordance with the current law and job requirements, the selected candidate will be requested to provide a criminal record (section 3).

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote a diverse and inclusive work environment for our employees and candidates. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are woven into the fabric of our Maison’s DNA, and we strive to ensure that our employees can fulfill both their personal and professional aspirations by encouraging internal mobility and individual upskilling programs. We firmly believe that building Diverse Teams contributes to our successes and to deliver on this, we actively embed Diversity, Equity and Inclusion in our business strategy.

It is an exciting time to join our Teams. All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence.

jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Account und Relationship Manager - Global Custody und Private Label Funds Kunden (80-100%)

Als Teil eines kleinen, dynamischen und kundenorientierten Teams sind Sie verantwortlich für die umfassende Betreuung von strategisch wichtigen institutionellen Kunden in der Deutschschweiz.

Stellenbeschreibung:

• Umfassende Betreuung der Global Custody- und Private Label Funds Kunden (inkl. Trouble Shooting) in folgenden Bereichen: Depotbankdienstleistungen, Fondsbuchhaltung, Transfer Agent Aktivitäten, Bankinfrastruktur-Dienstleistungen, Business Process Outsourcing usw.

• Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden und diversen internen Stellen in Zürich, Genf und Luxembourg (Fondsleitung, Fondsbuchhaltung, Wertschriften-Operations, IT, Legal, Tax etc.) sowie Drittparteien (Vermögensverwalter, Revisoren, Consultants etc.)

• Eigenständige Führung von vielseitigen Kundenprojekten und Business Analyst Arbeiten (z.B. Lancierung von Anlagefonds, Offertstellung bei neuen Produkten, Service Reviews, technische Umsetzung von regulatorischen Anforderungen, Analyse von Kundenbedürfnissen etc.).

• Selbständige Vor- und Nachbearbeitung von Kundenmeetings (Lenkungsausschuss, operative Meetings etc.) und Führung / Teilnahme der Meetings

• Aufsetzen und Unterhalt von Verträgen und SLAs mit Kunden

• Erstellung von Kunden- und Gebührenabrechnungen und Ausführung von Gebührenchecks

• Eröffnung und Unterhalt der Kunden- und Kontenbeziehungen (Sicherstellung der korrekten Dokumentation, Aktualisierung der Kontodokumente und Verträge nach bankinternen Richtlinien etc.)

• Unterstützung bei der Ausführung von verschiedenen operativen Tätigkeiten wie Cash Management, Zahlungsverkehr, Abrechnung und Überwachung intern und extern gehandelter FX sowie Optionen- und Futures-Transaktionen. Koordination und Verbuchung von Transaktionen von nicht-deponierten Werten wie z.B. Private Equity, Infrastrukturanlagen, Immobilien etc.

• Mithilfe bei der Erstellung und Qualitätskontrolle von monatlichen und quartalsweisen kundenspezifischen Investmentreports (v.a. Fonds-Factsheets) für traditionelle und alternative Anlagen

Anforderungsprofil:

• Banklehre mit Berufsmaturität und abgeschlossene Weiterbildung (Bankwirtschafter/in HF, CFA /AZEK) oder Hochschulabschluss

• Mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung im Finanzsektor, idealerweise in der Betreuung von institutionellen Kunden

• Breite Fachkenntnisse im Bereich Asset Servicing (z. B. im Bereich Wertschriften, Börse, Back-& Middle-Office, Anlageberatung). Erfahrung im Kontakt mit externen Vermögensverwaltern und / oder Global Custody / Fonds-Kunden von Vorteil.

• Interesse am Fondsgeschäft, an operativen Abläufen (Prozessen) und Investmentthemen, verbunden mit Freude an Zahlen und regelmässigem Kontakt zu internen und externen Stellen

• Sehr gute MS Office Anwenderkenntnisse

• Kunden- und bedürfnisorientiert, hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein, genaue und selbstständige Arbeitsweise

• Teamfähige, engagierte und kommunikative Persönlichkeit mit hoher Soz

descriptionByLocale.it:
Una carriera a Lombard Odier significa lavorare per una crescente ricchezza globale e asset manager, con un forte focus sugli investimenti sostenibili. Un'innovativa banca di scelta per clienti privati e istituzionali, il nostro Studio indipendente di proprietà è uno dei gruppi bancari più capitalizzati al mondo, che gestisce quasi 300 miliardi di franchi e opera da oltre 25 uffici in 4 continenti. Con una storia di oltre 230 anni, Lombard Odier è una casa di investimento che offre un'offerta completa di gestione del portafoglio discrezionale e consultivo, servizi di ricchezza e custodia. Offriamo quindi servizi di asset management e strategie di investimento attraverso Lombard Odier Investment Manager e fornire tecnologia bancaria avanzata ad altre istituzioni finanziarie. “Rethink Everything” è la nostra filosofia – è al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo. Siamo cresciuti attraverso più di 40 crisi finanziarie ripensando il mondo intorno a noi per fornire una nuova prospettiva di investimento per i nostri clienti. Account and Relationship Manager - Global Custody e Private Label Fund Clienti (80-100%) Come parte di un team piccolo, dinamico e orientato al cliente, siete responsabili del supporto completo di clienti istituzionali strategicamente importanti nella Svizzera tedesca. Descrizione del lavoro:
• Supporto completo per clienti Global Custody e Private Label Fund (inclusi Trouble Shooting) nelle seguenti aree: Servizi bancari del deposito, Contabilità del fondo, Attività agente di trasferimento, Servizi di infrastruttura bancaria, Outsourcing del processo di affari ecc.
• Interfaccia tra i clienti e varie agenzie interne a Zurigo, Ginevra e Lussemburgo (Fondsleitung, Fondsbuchhaltung, Wertschriften Legal-Operations.
• Gestione di vari progetti di clienti e lavori di analisti aziendali (ad esempio lancio di fondi di investimento, offerta per nuovi prodotti, recensioni di servizi, implementazione tecnica dei requisiti normativi, analisi delle esigenze del cliente, ecc.). Sostegno finanziario e prenotazione di transazioni di valori non dichiarati come private equity, infrastrutture, immobili ecc. Esperienza a contatto con gli asset manager esterni e/o Global Custody / clienti di fondo di vantaggio.
• Interessi nel settore dei fondi, nei processi operativi (processi) e nei problemi di investimento, combinati con la gioia dei numeri e il contatto regolare con gli enti interni ed esterni
• Ottima conoscenza degli utenti di MS Office
• Consapevolezza del cliente e della necessità, consapevolezza di alta qualità, lavoro accurato e indipendente
• Personalità attiva, impegnata e comunicativa con soz elevato

jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

With over 250 professionals, our Investment Solutions department is responsible for providing sophisticated and highly customized investment proposals to our private clients.

Equities & Derivatives Execution Trader (80-100%)

Mission:

• Equities & Derivatives Trade Execution: Execute, monitor, and optimize the bank’s equity and derivative client flows across global markets, ensuring consistent best execution in line with applicable regulatory requirements and internal governance frameworks. The ideal candidate will have a strong expertise in future and option strategies).

• Late Shift: Take part in cross asset execution coverage until the U.S. market close (each execution trader participating in a limited number of late shifts per month)

• Technology & Automation: Actively Contribute to the enhancement of electronic trading strategies, leveraging trading data and analytics to help design implement, and scale new automation process

• Counterparty Interaction: Maintain strong relationships with brokers and market makers to optimize execution and access liquidity

Your Profile:

• Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, or a related field

• Experience: Minimum of 3 years in derivatives and equity trading

• Technical Skills: Proficiency in Bloomberg, TradeWeb and order management systems

• Familiarity with algorithmic and electronic trading solutions is highly advantageous

• Analytical & Execution Skills: Strong market analysis capabilities, sound judgment under pressure, and ability to handle high trade volumes with precision and efficiency

• Communication : Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate clearly with senior management, counterparties, and technology teams

• Teamwork: Team-oriented mindset with the ability to collaborate effectively with investment professionals and clients

• Project skills: Proactive and detail-oriented, with a strong sense of initiative and active participation in cross-functional projects

• Languages: Fluent in both English and French

• Service minded, accurate, autonomous

• Must be a resident of Switzerland or willing to relocate

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote a diverse and inclusive work environment for our employees and candidates. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are woven into the fabric of our Maison’s DNA, and we strive to ensure that our employees can fulfill both their personal and professional aspirations by encouraging internal mobility and individual upskilling programs. We firmly believe that building Diverse Teams contributes to our successes and to deliver on this, we actively embed Diversity, Equity and Inclusion in our business strategy.

• Competenze di progetto: Proattive e orientate ai dettagli, con un forte senso di iniziativa e partecipazione attiva a progetti interfunzionali

jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Business Risk Manager - Technology & Operations (80-100%)

As part of the Technology & Operations (T&O) Business Risk Management team, you will partner with stakeholders across Operations and Technology to identify key risks, coordinate remediation, and strengthen first‑line ownership of controls. You will contribute to the effective oversight of operational, technology and information risks, and ensure transparent and timely reporting to management.

YOUR ROLE

Risk Identification, Assessment & Reporting

• Identify, assess, and report operational risks, including processing, trade order execution, operational taxes, technology, cybersecurity, and information‑related risks across T&O.

• Support the RCSA process and ensure risk assessments remain current, well‑documented, and evidence‑based.

• Manage the T&O incident process, ensuring incidents are recorded, analysed, escalated, and followed through to closure.

Control Environment Oversight

• Contribute to the T&O Risk Assurance Plan through thematic reviews, independent design and operating effectiveness testing of the control environment, and follow‑up of identified gaps.

• Support the ISAE control framework, ensuring required evidence is collected, complete, and audit‑ready.

Remediation & Issue Management

• Drive, coordinate, and track risk remediation activities, ensuring actions are well defined, owned, and delivered on time.

• Monitor and report on the progression of identified issues, ensuring consistent closure, documentation, and controls uplift.

Governance, Assurance & Culture

• Promote a strong risk culture by supporting awareness, training, and constructive challenge across teams.

• Prepare structured and insightful risk reports to the T&O Risk Committee and senior management.

YOUR PROFILE

• Minimum 5 years' experience in risk management, internal control, audit, or consulting (e.g., Big Four) with focus on operational or technology‑related risks.

• Solid understanding of operations, IT, cybersecurity, and information risk, ideally within financial services.

• Strong analytical mindset with a structured, detail‑oriented approach.

• Excellent communication skills in English and French, with the ability to challenge stakeholders constructively.

• Resident in Switzerland or willingness to relocate

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote a diverse and inclusive work environment for our employees and candidates. Siamo cresciuti più forti attraverso più di 40 crisi finanziarie ripensando il mondo intorno a noi per fornire una nuova prospettiva di investimento per i nostri clienti. Business Risk Manager - Tecnologia e Operazioni (80-100%) Nell'ambito del team Technology & Operations (T&O) Business Risk Management, partnerrai con gli stakeholder di Operazioni e Tecnologie per identificare i rischi chiave, coordinare la bonifica e rafforzare la proprietà di prima linea dei controlli. Contribuirai all'effettiva supervisione dei rischi operativi, tecnologici e informativi e garantirai un reporting trasparente e tempestivo alla gestione. Il tuo! Identificazione del rischio, valutazione e reportistica
• Identificare, valutare e segnalare i rischi operativi, tra cui il trattamento, l'esecuzione degli ordini commerciali, le imposte operative, la tecnologia, la sicurezza informatica e i rischi correlati alle informazioni in T&O.
• Sostenere il processo RCSA e garantire che le valutazioni dei rischi rimangano attuali, ben documentate e basate su prove.
• Gestisci il processo di incidente T&O, assicurando che gli incidenti siano registrati, analizzati, escalati e seguiti fino alla chiusura. Controllo dell'ambiente
• Contribuire al T&O Risk Assurance Plan attraverso revisioni tematiche, progettazione indipendente e test di efficacia operativa dell'ambiente di controllo e follow-up di lacune identificate.
• Supporta il quadro di controllo ISAE, assicurando che le prove richieste siano raccolte, complete e pronte all'audit. Remediazione e gestione dei problemi
• Guidare, coordinare e monitorare le attività di bonifica dei rischi, garantire che le azioni siano ben definite, possedute e consegnate in tempo.
• Monitorare e segnalare la progressione dei problemi identificati, assicurando la chiusura coerente, la documentazione e i controlli di sollevamento. Governance, assicurazione e cultura
• Promuovere una forte cultura del rischio sostenendo la consapevolezza, la formazione e la sfida costruttiva tra le squadre.
• Preparare rapporti di rischio strutturati e intuitivi al comitato di rischio T&O e alla gestione senior. Il tuo progetto
• Esperienza minima di 5 anni nella gestione del rischio, nel controllo interno, nell'audit o nella consulenza (ad esempio, Big Four) con particolare attenzione ai rischi operativi o tecnologici.
• Solida comprensione delle operazioni, IT, sicurezza informatica e rischi di informazione, idealmente all'interno dei servizi finanziari.
• Forte mentalità analitica con un approccio strutturato e orientato al dettaglio.
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione in inglese e francese, con la capacità di sfidare gli stakeholder costruttivamente.
• Residente in Svizzera o disponibilità a trasferirsi Il DNA della nostra Maison è definito da cinque valori fondamentali. L'eccellenza ci spinge ad essere i migliori a quello che facciamo, mentre l'innovazione alimenta i nostri progressi. Il rispetto sostiene ogni interazione, e l'integrità plasma le nostre azioni. Insieme, siamo un team unico, uniti nel servire i nostri clienti con dedizione inaspettata. Come datore di lavoro responsabile e di supporto, promuoviamo un ambiente di lavoro diversificato e inclusivo per i nostri dipendenti e candidati. Diversità, equità e inclusione sono intrecciati nel tessuto del DNA della nostra Maison, e ci sforziamo di garantire che i nostri dipendenti possano soddisfare sia le loro aspirazioni personali che professionali incoraggiando la mobilità interna e programmi di upskilling individuali. Noi crediamo fermamente

Eine Karriere bei Lombard Odier bedeutet, für einen renommierten globalen Vermögens- und Vermögensverwalter mit einem starken Fokus auf nachhaltige Investitionen zu arbeiten. Eine innovative Bank der Wahl für private und institutionelle Kunden, unser unabhängiger Eigentümer Firm ist eine der besten Bankengruppen der Welt, die in der Nähe von CHF 300 Milliarden verwaltet und von über 25 Büros auf 4 Kontinenten. Lombard Odier ist mit einer über 230-jährigen Geschichte ein Investmenthaus, das ein umfassendes Angebot an diskreten und beratenden Portfolio-Management, Vermögensdienstleistungen und Sorge bietet. Wir bieten auch Asset-Management-Dienste und Anlagestrategien durch Lombard Odier Investment Manager und bieten fortschrittliche Banktechnologie an andere Finanzinstitute. „Rethink Everything“ ist unsere Philosophie – es liegt im Herzen von allem, was wir tun. Wir sind durch mehr als 40 Finanzkrisen stärker gewachsen, indem wir die Welt um uns herum neu denken, um unseren Kunden eine neue Investitionsperspektive zu bieten. Business Risk Manager - Technologie & Operations (80-100%) Im Rahmen des Teams Technology & Operations (T&O) Business Risk Management werden Sie mit Stakeholdern in allen Bereichen Operations und Technologie zusammenarbeiten, um Schlüsselrisiken zu identifizieren, Abhilfe zu koordinieren und das Eigentum an Kontrollen im ersten Bereich zu stärken. Sie werden zur effektiven Überwachung von Betriebs-, Technologie- und Informationsrisiken beitragen und eine transparente und rechtzeitige Berichterstattung an das Management gewährleisten. IHRE ROLLE Risikoidentifikation, Bewertung und Reporting
• Ermittlung, Bewertung und Meldung operativer Risiken, einschließlich der Abwicklung, der Ausführung von Handelsaufträgen, operativen Steuern, Technologien, Cybersicherheit und informationsbezogenen Risiken im gesamten T&O.
• Unterstützung des RCSA-Prozesses und Gewährleistung der Risikobewertungen bleiben aktuell, gut dokumentiert und evidenzbasiert.
• Verwalten des T&O-Vorfallsprozesses, so dass Vorkommnisse aufgezeichnet, analysiert, eskaliert werden und bis zur Schließung folgen. Kontrolle Umweltaufsicht
• Beitrag zum T&O-Risiko-Assurance-Plan durch thematische Überprüfungen, unabhängige Design- und Betriebswirksamkeitsprüfungen der Kontrollumgebung und Folgemaßnahmen identifizierter Lücken.
• Unterstützung des Kontrollrahmens der ISAE, um sicherzustellen, dass die erforderlichen Beweise gesammelt, vollständig und auditbereit sind. Zurück zur Übersicht
• Fahr-, Koordinaten- und Tracking-Risiko-Remediation-Aktivitäten, Sicherstellung von Maßnahmen sind gut definiert, im Besitz und pünktlich geliefert.
• Überwachen und berichten Sie über die Fortschritte identifizierter Probleme, um eine einheitliche Schließung, Dokumentation und Kontrolle zu gewährleisten. Governance, Versicherung und Kultur
• Förderung einer starken Risikokultur durch Unterstützung von Bewusstsein, Schulung und konstruktiver Herausforderung in Teams.
• Bereiten Sie strukturierte und aufschlussreiche Risikoberichte an den T&O-Risikoausschuss und das Senior Management vor. IHRE PROFILE
• Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in Risikomanagement, interne Kontrolle, Audit oder Beratung (z.B. Big Four) mit Fokus auf operationelle oder technologiebezogene Risiken.
• Solides Verständnis von Operationen, IT, Cybersicherheit und Informationsrisiko, ideal innerhalb von Finanzdienstleistungen.
• Starke analytische Denkweise mit einem strukturierten, detailorientierten Ansatz.
• Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten auf Englisch und Französisch, mit der Fähigkeit, Interessenvertreter konstruktiv herauszufordern.
• Wohnsitz in der Schweiz oder Standortverlagerung Die DNA unseres Hauses wird durch fünf Kernwerte definiert. Exzellenz treibt uns dazu, das Beste zu sein, während Innovation unseren Fortschritt vorantreibt. Respekt unterstützt jede Interaktion und Integrität prägt unsere Handlungen. Gemeinsam sind wir ein Team, vereint in der Betreuung unserer Kunden mit unerschütterlicher Hingabe. Als verantwortungsbewusster und unterstützender Arbeitgeber fördern wir ein vielfältiges und inklusives Arbeitsumfeld für unsere Mitarbeiter und Kandidaten. Diversity, Equity und Inclusion sind in den Stoff unserer Maison’s DNA gewebt, und wir bemühen uns, sicherzustellen, dass unsere Mitarbeiter ihre persönlichen und beruflichen Bestrebungen erfüllen können, indem wir interne Mobilität und individuelle Upskilling-Programme fördern. Wir glauben fest

Avec une histoire de plus de 230 ans, Lombard Odier est une maison d'investissement offrant une offre complète de gestion de portefeuille discrétionnaire et consultative, de services de patrimoine et de garde. Nous offrons également des services de gestion d'actifs et des stratégies d'investissement par l'intermédiaire de Lombard Odier Investment Managers et fournissons une technologie bancaire avancée à d'autres institutions financières. Repensez Tout est notre philosophie – elle est au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. Nous sommes devenus plus forts grâce à plus de 40 crises financières en repensant le monde qui nous entoure pour offrir une nouvelle perspective d'investissement à nos clients. Vous contribuerez à la surveillance efficace des risques opérationnels, technologiques et d'information, et vous assurerez la transparence et la rapidité des rapports à la direction. • Identifier, évaluer et signaler les risques opérationnels, y compris le traitement, l'exécution des ordres commerciaux, les taxes opérationnelles, la technologie, la cybersécurité et les risques liés à l'information dans l'ensemble des T et O.
• Appuyer le processus d'évaluation des risques et veiller à ce que les évaluations des risques demeurent à jour, bien documentées et fondées sur des données probantes.

• Appuyer le cadre de contrôle de l'ISAE, en veillant à ce que les preuves requises soient recueillies, complètes et prêtes à être vérifiées. Remise en état et gestion des enjeux
• Diriger, coordonner et suivre les activités d'assainissement des risques, en veillant à ce que les actions soient bien définies, détenues et exécutées à temps.
• Surveiller l'évolution des problèmes identifiés et en rendre compte, en veillant à ce que la fermeture, la documentation et les contrôles soient uniformes. Gouvernance, assurance et culture
• Promouvoir une forte culture du risque en appuyant la sensibilisation, la formation et les défis constructifs entre les équipes.
• Préparer des rapports structurés et perspicaces sur les risques à l'intention du Comité des risques des T et O et de la haute direction. VOTRE PROFIL

Stagiaire - Database Administration & Observability Specialist (Foglight / Elastic)

Dans le cadre du renforcement de la supervision des bases de données et du déploiement d’une plateforme d’observabilité centralisée, l’équipe DBA recherche un(e) stagiaire pour accompagner un projet stratégique autour de Foglight (monitoring bases de données) et de son intégration avec la plateforme Elastic utilisée à l’échelle de la banque.

Ce stage offre une exposition concrète à des environnements bancaires critiques , des technologies de supervision modernes et à un projet transverse impliquant plusieurs équipes IT (DBA, Systèmes, Sécurité, Observabilité).

Le/la stagiaire accompagnera l’équipe DBA dans le suivi, la coordination, le déploiement et la documentation du projet Foglight, ainsi que dans son intégration avec la plateforme d’observabilité Elastic .

Le stage combine :

• Pilotage fonctionnel de projet,

• Mise en œuvre technique encadrée,

• Communication et documentation,

• Découverte des bonnes pratiques de supervision en milieu bancaire.

VOTRE MISSION

1. Pilotage et coordination du projet Foglight

• Participer au suivi du planning global Foglight & Elastic .

• Organiser et coordonner les réunions avec :

• Les référents des différentes technologies DB au sein de l’équipe DBA,

• Les équipes Systèmes, Sécurité et Observabilité.

• Préparer les comptes-rendus , tableaux de suivi et reportings d’avancement.

• Contribuer à la circulation fluide de l’information entre les équipes.

2. Implémentation de la supervision Foglight

Accompagné(e) par les experts DBA, le/la stagiaire participera à :

• L’ajout des environnements Test / UAT / Production dans Foglight.

• La validation des métriques collectées pour les différents SGBD.

• La création de dashboards de santé haut niveau par technologie.

• La définition et le paramétrage des alertes pertinentes .

• L’intégration avec ServiceNow pour l’ouverture automatique d’incidents.

• L’intégration avec Elastic pour la remontée des métriques de supervision.

3. Documentation et structuration

• Rédiger et maintenir la documentation projet .

• Produire la documentation fonctionnelle de l’intégration Foglight → Elastic .

• Créer des guides utilisateurs et procédures internes destinés aux équipes IT.

4. Support à la formation interne

• Préparer des supports de formation (présentations, guides).

• Contribuer à l’organisation et au bon déroulement de sessions de formation internes sur Foglight et Elastic.

5. Communication et visibilité du projet

• Préparer les communications internes officielles liées au projet.

• Mettre à jour les espaces Confluence / Teams .

• Participer à la communication autour des sujets d’ observabilité au sein de la banque.

Missions spécifiques – Observabilité Elastic

• Recueillir et formaliser les besoins en métriques, alertes et dashboards Elastic.

• Décrire fonctionnellement les flux de données Foglight → Elastic .

• Coordonner les échanges entre l’équipe DBA et l’équipe O

• Functional project management,
• Technical implementation supervised,
• Communication and documentation,
• Discovers good banking supervisory practices. YOUR MISSION 1. Steering and coordination of the Foglight project
• Participate in the follow-up of the global planning Foglight & Elastic .

• The DBA team's various DB technologies,
• Systems, Security and Observability teams.

• The creation of high-level health dashboards by technology.

• Integration with ServiceNow for automatic opening of incidents.
• Integration with Elastic for the uplift of the monitoring metrics. 3. Documentation and structuring

• Produce functional documentation of Foglight → Elastic integration.
• Create user guides and internal procedures for IT teams. 4. Support for in-house training
• Prepare training materials (presentations, guides).
• Contribute to the organization and smooth running of internal training sessions on Foglight and Elastic. 5. Project communication and visibility
• Prepare formal internal communications related to the project.
• Update Confluence / Teams spaces.
• Participate in communication on subjects of observability within the bank. Specific missions – Elastic Observability
• Collect and formalize Elastic metric, alert and dashboard requirements.
• Functionally describe Foglight → Elastic data streams.
• Coordinate exchanges between the DBA team and Team O

Eine Karriere bei Lombard Odier bedeutet, für einen renommierten globalen Vermögensverwalter mit einem starken Fokus auf nachhaltiges Investieren zu arbeiten. Als innovative Bank der Wahl für private und institutionelle Kunden ist unser unabhängiges Unternehmen eine der bestkapitalisierten Bankengruppen der Welt, verwaltet fast 300 Milliarden CHF und ist in über 25 Niederlassungen auf vier Kontinenten tätig. Mit einer über 230-jährigen Geschichte ist Lombard Odier ein Investmenthaus, das ein umfassendes Angebot an diskretionärer und beratender Portfolioverwaltung, Vermögensdienstleistungen und Verwahrung anbietet. Darüber hinaus bieten wir über Lombard Odier Investment Managers Vermögensverwaltungsdienstleistungen und Anlagestrategien an und stellen anderen Finanzinstituten fortschrittliche Banktechnologie zur Verfügung. „Alles neu denken“ ist unsere Philosophie – sie steht im Mittelpunkt unseres Handelns. Wir sind durch mehr als 40 Finanzkrisen stärker geworden, indem wir die Welt um uns herum neu überdacht haben, um unseren Kunden eine neue Investitionsperspektive zu bieten. Praktikant – Datenbankverwaltungs- und Observability-Spezialist (Foglight/Elastic) Im Rahmen der Stärkung der Datenbanküberwachung und der Bereitstellung einer zentralisierten Observability-Plattform sucht das DBA-Team einen Praktikanten, der ein strategisches Projekt rund um Foglight (Überwachung von Datenbanken) und dessen Integration mit der in der gesamten Bank verwendeten Elastic-Plattform unterstützt. Dieses Praktikum bietet einen konkreten Einblick in kritische Bankumgebungen, moderne Überwachungstechnologien und ein funktionsübergreifendes Projekt, an dem mehrere IT-Teams beteiligt sind (DBA, Systeme, Sicherheit, Observability). Der Praktikant unterstützt das DBA-Team bei der Überwachung, Koordination, Bereitstellung und Dokumentation des Foglight-Projekts sowie bei seiner Integration mit der Elastic Observability-Plattform. Das Praktikum kombiniert:
• Funktionales Projektmanagement,
• Beaufsichtigte technische Umsetzung,
• Kommunikation und Dokumentation,
• Entdeckung guter Aufsichtspraktiken im Bankenumfeld. IHRE AUFGABE 1. Management und Koordination des Foglight-Projekts
• Beteiligen Sie sich an der Überwachung der gesamten Foglight- und Elastic-Planung.
• Organisieren und koordinieren Sie Besprechungen mit:
• Den Vertretern der verschiedenen DB-Technologien innerhalb des DBA-Teams,
• Den System-, Sicherheits- und Observability-Teams.
• Erstellen Sie Berichte, Überwachungstabellen und Fortschrittsberichte.
• Tragen Sie zum reibungslosen Informationsfluss zwischen den Teams bei. 2. Implementierung der Foglight-Überwachung. Begleitet von DBA-Experten wird der Praktikant an Folgendem teilnehmen:
• Der Hinzufügung von Test-/UAT-/Produktionsumgebungen in Foglight.
• Validierung der für die verschiedenen DBMS gesammelten Metriken.
• Die Erstellung von Gesundheits-Dashboards auf hoher Ebene mithilfe von Technologie.
• Definition und Konfiguration relevanter Alarme.
• Integration mit ServiceNow zum automatischen Öffnen von Vorfällen.
• Integration mit Elastic für die Berichterstellung von Überwachungsmetriken. 3. Dokumentation und Strukturierung
• Projektdokumentation erstellen und pflegen.
• Erstellen Sie eine funktionale Dokumentation für die Foglight → Elastic-Integration.
• Erstellen Sie Benutzerhandbücher und interne Verfahren für IT-Teams. 4. Interne Schulungsunterstützung
• Bereiten Sie Schulungsmaterialien vor (Präsentationen, Leitfäden).
• Tragen Sie zur Organisation und zum reibungslosen Ablauf interner Schulungssitzungen zu Foglight und Elastic bei. 5. Projektkommunikation und Sichtbarkeit
• Bereiten Sie offizielle interne Kommunikationen im Zusammenhang mit dem Projekt vor.
• Aktualisieren Sie Confluence/Teams-Bereiche.
• Beteiligen Sie sich an der Kommunikation zu Observability-Fragen innerhalb der Bank. Spezifische Missionen – Elastic Observability
• Erfassen und formalisieren Sie den Bedarf an Elastic-Metriken, -Warnungen und -Dashboards.
• Funktionale Beschreibung von Foglight → elastischen Datenflüssen.
• Koordinieren Sie den Austausch zwischen dem DBA-Team und dem O-Team

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Business Manager – Platform Delivery & Client Engagement (80–100%)

Lombard Odier provides its proprietary private‑banking platform to a growing number of external institutions via an ITO/BPO model. Banking Platform Services (BPS) acts as the central interface with these Partner Banks, coordinating platform delivery, change management, and service operations.
To strengthen our operating model, we are looking for a Business Manager dedicated to enhancing our processes, standardizing client‑engagement practices, and implementing the tools that allow us to manage the change roadmap, service cases, and governance frameworks effectively.

YOUR ROLE

• Define, standardize, and continuously improve processes across BPS (change management, case management, governance, reporting).

• Implement and maintain best‑in‑class tooling for client‑relationship workflows, including roadmap oversight, demand intake, service‑management cases, KPIs, and dashboards.

• Work closely with Client Platform Advisors and Relationship Managers to ensure consistent client experience and delivery quality across all Partner Banks.

• Coordinate cross‑functional initiatives with IT, Product, Operations, and Risk to streamline how client demands are captured, assessed, and executed.

• Lead internal projects aimed at increasing operational efficiency, transparency, and scalability.

• Drive documentation standards and support internal knowledge‑management practices.

• Monitor platform evolution and ensure all client‑facing processes remain aligned with strategic priorities.

YOUR PROFILE

• University degree in business, technology, operations, or a related field.

• 5+ years’ experience in consulting, business- or project management in financial services or technology.

• Strong understanding of operating models, process optimisation, and tooling implementation.

• Experience with service‑management or project‑management solutions (ServiceNow, Jira, Confluence, PowerBI, etc.).

• Excellent organisational, analytical, and communication skills.

• Ability to work with multiple stakeholders and drive change across teams.

• Fluency in French and English.

• Resident in Switzerland or willingness to relocate.

Con una storia di oltre 230 anni, Lombard Odier è una casa di investimento che offre un'offerta completa di gestione del portafoglio discrezionale e consultivo, servizi di ricchezza e custodia. Siamo cresciuti più forti attraverso più di 40 crisi finanziarie ripensando il mondo intorno a noi per fornire una nuova prospettiva di investimento per i nostri clienti. Business Manager – Consegna della piattaforma e coinvolgimento dei clienti (80-100%) Lombard Odier fornisce la sua piattaforma proprietaria di private-banking ad un numero crescente di istituzioni esterne tramite un modello ITO/BPO. Banking Platform Services (BPS) funge da interfaccia centrale con queste banche partner, coordinando le operazioni di distribuzione della piattaforma, gestione dei cambiamenti e servizio. Per rafforzare il nostro modello operativo, stiamo cercando un Business Manager dedicato a migliorare i nostri processi, standardizzare le pratiche di customer-engagement e implementare gli strumenti che ci permettono di gestire in modo efficace la modifica della roadmap, dei casi di servizio e dei framework di governance. Il tuo!
• Definire, standardizzare e migliorare continuamente i processi in BPS (gestione dei cambiamenti, gestione dei casi, governance, reporting).
• Implementazione e manutenzione di strumenti di classe migliore per i flussi di lavoro di relazione client, tra cui roadmap supervisione, assunzione della domanda, casi di gestione del servizio, KPI e dashboard.
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con Client Platform Advisors e Relationship Manager per garantire un'esperienza client coerente e qualità di consegna in tutte le banche partner.
• Coordinare le iniziative interfunzionali con IT, Prodotto, Operazioni e Rischi per semplificare il modo in cui le richieste dei clienti vengono catturate, valutate e eseguite.
• Condurre progetti interni volti ad aumentare l'efficienza operativa, la trasparenza e la scalabilità.
• Guidare gli standard di documentazione e sostenere le pratiche di gestione della conoscenza interna.
• Monitorare l'evoluzione della piattaforma e garantire che tutti i processi orientati al cliente rimangano allineati con priorità strategiche. Il tuo progetto
• Laurea in economia, tecnologia, operazioni o un campo correlato.
• 5+ anni di esperienza nella consulenza, business- o project management nei servizi finanziari o nella tecnologia.
• Forte comprensione dei modelli operativi, ottimizzazione dei processi e implementazione degli utensili.
• Esperienza con soluzioni di gestione del servizio o di gestione del progetto (ServiceNow, Jira, Confluence, PowerBI, ecc.).
• Ottimi capacità organizzative, analitiche e di comunicazione.
• Capacità di lavorare con più stakeholder e guidare il cambiamento tra le squadre.
• Fluency in francese e inglese.
• Residente in Svizzera o disponibilità a trasferirsi. Il DNA della nostra Maison è definito da cinque valori fondamentali. L'eccellenza ci spinge ad essere i migliori a quello che facciamo, mentre l'innovazione alimenta i nostri progressi. Il rispetto sostiene ogni interazione, e l'integrità plasma le nostre azioni. Insieme, siamo un team unico, uniti nel servire i nostri clienti con dedizione inaspettata. Come datore di lavoro responsabile e di supporto, promuoviamo un ambiente di lavoro diversificato e inclusivo per i nostri dipendenti e candidati. Diversità, equità e inclusione sono intrecciati nel tessuto del DNA della nostra Maison, e ci sforziamo di garantire che i nostri dipendenti possano soddisfare sia le loro aspirazioni personali che professionali incoraggiando la mobilità interna e programmi di upskilling individuali. Crediamo fermamente che la costruzione di Diverse Teams contribuisca ai nostri successi e a fornire su questo, embe attivamente

Avec une histoire de plus de 230 ans, Lombard Odier est une maison d'investissement offrant une offre complète de gestion de portefeuille discrétionnaire et consultative, de services de patrimoine et de garde. jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Junior Business Analyst - Client Platform Advisory (80-100%)

Lombard Odier has developed a proprietary, fully integrated private‑banking platform used by the Group and by external financial institutions through a BPO/ITO delivery model. Our Technology & Operations division builds, operates, and continually evolves this platform.

We are looking for a Junior Client Platform Advisor to join our Banking Platform Services (BPS) team. In this role, you will support senior advisors in delivering high‑quality platform services to our Partner Banks, helping them make the most of our core‑banking technology (G2/GX). This position offers a unique opportunity to grow into a client‑facing advisory role while developing strong expertise in private‑banking processes and technology.

YOUR ROLE

• Support senior advisors in managing day‑to‑day interactions with Partner Banks and understanding their platform needs.

• Assist in gathering, analyzing, and prioritizing client requests across multiple functional domains.

• Contribute to translating business needs into clear requirements for IT and Operations teams.

• Help track change requests, roadmap items, and platform enhancements.

• Develop familiarity with LO’s proprietary private‑banking platform and its front‑to‑back architecture.

• Participate in workshops, testing activities, and internal coordination meetings.

• Stay informed about platform evolutions and industry trends in wealth‑management technology.

YOUR PROFILE

• University degree in business, IT, finance, or a related field.

• 1–3 years’ experience in banking, consulting, business analysis, or technology (internships included).

• Familiarity with project‑management or collaboration tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, MS Office) is a plus.

• Strong interest in private banking, digital platforms, and process optimization.

• Analytical mindset with the ability to synthesize complex topics.

• Team player with strong communication skills and willingness to learn.

• Fluency in French and English.

• Resident in Switzerland or willingness to relocate.

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote a diverse and inclusive work environment for our employees and candidates. • Sviluppare familiarità con la piattaforma privata proprietaria di LO-banking e la sua architettura front-to-back.

• Rimanere informati sulle evoluzioni della piattaforma e le tendenze del settore nella tecnologia di gestione della ricchezza. Il tuo progetto
• Laurea in economia, IT, finanza, o un campo correlato.
• 1–3 anni di esperienza nel settore bancario, della consulenza, dell’analisi aziendale o della tecnologia (internship inclusi).
• La familiarità con strumenti di gestione del progetto o di collaborazione (ad esempio, Jira, Confluence, MS Office) è un vantaggio.
• Forte interesse per il private banking, piattaforme digitali e ottimizzazione dei processi.
• mentalità analitica con la capacità di sintetizzare argomenti complessi.

• Fluency in francese e inglese.

YOUR PROFILE

• Completed banking apprenticeship; ideally supplemented by a completed or ongoing degree in business administration or business information technology

• Several years of experience in banking Middle and Back Office activities

• Good command of securities operations

• Excellent interpersonal skills, client-oriented mindset, strong attention to details, good stakeholders’ management skills

• Ability to manage deadlines in a dynamic, multidisciplinary, and transversal environment

• Proficient in French and English, German proficiency will be appreciated

• Resident in Switzerland or willingness to relocate

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote a diverse and inclusive work environment for our employees and candidates. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are woven into the fabric of our Maison’s DNA, and we strive to ensure that our employees can fulfill both their personal and professional aspirations by encouraging internal mobility and individual upskilling programs. We firmly believe that building Diverse Teams contributes to our successes and to deliver on this, we actively embed Diversity, Equity and Inclusion in our business strategy.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Eine Karriere bei Lombard Odier bedeutet, für einen renommierten globalen Vermögens- und Vermögensverwalter mit einem starken Fokus auf nachhaltige Investitionen zu arbeiten. Eine innovative Bank der Wahl für private und institutionelle Kunden, unser unabhängiger Eigentümer Firm ist eine der besten Bankengruppen der Welt, die in der Nähe von CHF 300 Milliarden verwaltet und von über 25 Büros auf 4 Kontinenten. Lombard Odier ist mit einer über 230-jährigen Geschichte ein Investmenthaus, das ein umfassendes Angebot an diskreten und beratenden Portfolio-Management, Vermögensdienstleistungen und Sorge bietet. Wir bieten auch Asset-Management-Dienste und Anlagestrategien durch Lombard Odier Investment Manager und bieten fortschrittliche Banktechnologie an andere Finanzinstitute. „Rethink Everything“ ist unsere Philosophie – es liegt im Herzen von allem, was wir tun. Wir sind durch mehr als 40 Finanzkrisen stärker gewachsen, indem wir die Welt um uns herum neu denken, um unseren Kunden eine neue Investitionsperspektive zu bieten. Operations Support Specialist - Houston Team (80-100%) Werden Sie ein wichtiges Mitglied unseres dynamischen neun-Personen-Teams innerhalb der Abteilung Operationen und werden Sie zum zentralen Ansprechpartner für einen großen Teamumfang und unterstützen unser Geschäft aktiv. Als zentrale Schnittstelle bei T&O Operations für eine breite Palette von internen Kunden in Front-Teams oder anderen Abteilungen in Genf, Luxemburg und Singapur sorgen Sie für reibungslose und effektive Operationen. IHRE ROLLE
• Kommunikations-Hub: Gesetz als einziger Ansprechpartner für interne Fragen im Zusammenhang mit Wertpapier-Transfers, Abrechnungen, Fonds, Sorge, Cash-Services, Steuerberichterstattung und Edelmetallen. Probleme unabhängig mit einer lösungsorientierten Denkweise lösen.
• Risikobewusstsein: Bewahren Sie hohe Wachsamkeit und Risikobewusstsein, um operative Risiken effektiv zu identifizieren, zu bewerten und zu priorisieren.
• Innovation: Entwickeln Sie kreative Lösungen, die den Erwartungen der Kunden gerecht werden, während Sie sich an interne Politiken, Bankvorschriften und rechtliche Anforderungen halten.
• Kundenorientierung : regelmäßige Berichte über die operative Leistungsfähigkeit, Trends zu identifizieren und Verbesserungen vorzuschlagen. Organisieren Sie Feedback-Sessions mit internen Kunden.
• Zusammenarbeit: Unterstützung interner Teams und Operationen bei der Verwaltung von Projekten, Überwachung von Ausnahmen und Bereitstellung konstruktiver Rückmeldungen.
• Operationelle Exzellenz: Errichten Sie umfassendes Know-how über Bankgeschäfte (z.B. Unternehmensaktionen, Fonds, Steuern, Rechnungslegung, Abwicklungen, Zahlungen) und tragen Sie zu einem Wissenszentrum für mittlere Bürofunktionen bei. IHRE PROFILE
• Abgeschlossene Banklehre; ideal ergänzt durch einen abgeschlossenen oder laufenden Abschluss in der Betriebswirtschafts- oder Wirtschaftsinformationstechnologie
• Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung im Bankwesen Middle and Back Office Aktivitäten
• Guter Befehl von Wertpapiergeschäften
• Ausgezeichnete zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten, kundenorientiertes Denken, starke Aufmerksamkeit auf Details, gute Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten
• Fähigkeit, Termine in einer dynamischen, multidisziplinären und transversalen Umgebung zu verwalten
• Proficient auf Französisch und Englisch, Deutschkenntnisse werden geschätzt
• Wohnsitz in der Schweiz oder Standortverlagerung Die DNA unseres Hauses wird durch fünf Kernwerte definiert. Exzellenz treibt uns dazu, das Beste zu sein, während Innovation unseren Fortschritt vorantreibt. Respekt unterstützt jede Interaktion und Integrität prägt unsere Handlungen. Gemeinsam sind wir ein Team, vereint in der Betreuung unserer Kunden mit unerschütterlicher Hingabe. Als verantwortungsbewusster und unterstützender Arbeitgeber fördern wir ein vielfältiges und inklusives Arbeitsumfeld für unsere Mitarbeiter und Kandidaten. Diversity, Equity und Inclusion sind in den Stoff unserer Maison’s DNA gewebt, und wir bemühen uns, sicherzustellen, dass unsere Mitarbeiter ihre persönlichen und beruflichen Bestrebungen erfüllen können, indem wir interne Mobilität und individuelle Upskilling-Programme fördern. Wir sind fest davon überzeugt, dass der Aufbau von Diverse Teams zu unseren Erfolgen beiträgt und dass wir darauf aktiv Diversity, Equity und Inclusion in unsere Geschäftsstrategie einbetten.
