descriptionByLocale.fr:
Une carrière chez Lombard Odier signifie travailler pour un gérant mondial de patrimoine et d'actifs renommé, avec un accent fort sur l'investissement durable. Banque innovante de choix pour les clients privés et institutionnels, notre entreprise indépendante est l'un des groupes bancaires les mieux capitalisés au monde, gérant près de CHF 300 milliards et opérant depuis plus de 25 bureaux sur 4 continents. Avec une histoire de plus de 230 ans, Lombard Odier est une maison d'investissement offrant une offre complète de gestion de portefeuille discrétionnaire et consultative, de services de patrimoine et de garde. Nous offrons également des services de gestion d'actifs et des stratégies d'investissement par l'intermédiaire de Lombard Odier Investment Managers et fournissons une technologie bancaire avancée à d'autres institutions financières. Repensez Tout est notre philosophie – elle est au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. Nous sommes devenus plus forts grâce à plus de 40 crises financières en repensant le monde qui nous entoure pour offrir une nouvelle perspective d'investissement à nos clients. Spécialiste du soutien opérationnel - équipe de Houston (80-100%) Devenez un membre clé de notre équipe dynamique de neuf personnes au sein du département Opérations et devenez le point de contact central pour un large éventail d'équipes et soutient activement nos activités. En tant qu'interface centrale au sein de T&O Operations pour un large éventail de clients internes dans les équipes de front ou d'autres départements à Genève, Luxembourg et Singapour, vous assurerez des opérations fluides et efficaces. Votre rôle
• Centre de communication: agir en tant que point de contact unique pour les questions internes relatives aux transferts de valeurs mobilières, aux règlements, aux fonds, à la garde, aux services en espèces, aux déclarations fiscales et aux métaux précieux. Résolvez les problèmes de façon indépendante avec un état d'esprit orienté vers la solution.
• Sensibilisation aux risques : maintenir une vigilance élevée et une sensibilisation aux risques pour identifier, évaluer et prioriser efficacement les risques opérationnels.
• Innovation : Développer des solutions créatives qui répondent aux attentes des clients tout en respectant les politiques internes, les réglementations bancaires et les exigences légales.
• L'accent est mis sur les clients : fournir régulièrement des rapports sur le rendement opérationnel, identifier les tendances et suggérer des améliorations. Organiser des séances de rétroaction avec des clients internes.
• Collaboration : Soutenir les équipes et les opérations internes dans la gestion des projets, le suivi des exceptions et la fourniture de rétroaction constructive.
• Excellence opérationnelle : Développer une vaste expertise dans l'ensemble des opérations bancaires (par exemple, actions d'entreprise, fonds, impôts, facturation, règlements, paiements) et contribuer à un centre de connaissances pour les fonctions des bureaux intermédiaires. VOTRE PROFIL
• Apprentissage bancaire terminé; idéalement complété par un diplôme complet ou continu en administration des affaires ou en technologie de l'information commerciale
• Plusieurs années d'expérience dans les activités bancaires au Moyen et au Back Office
• Bonne maîtrise des opérations sur titres
• Excellentes aptitudes interpersonnelles, esprit orienté client, attention aux détails, bonnes compétences de gestion
• Capacité de gérer les délais dans un environnement dynamique, multidisciplinaire et transversal
• Compétence en français et anglais, compétence allemande sera apprécié
• Résident en Suisse ou volonté de déménager L'ADN de la Maison est défini par cinq valeurs fondamentales. L'excellence nous pousse à être les meilleurs dans ce que nous faisons, tandis que l'innovation alimente nos progrès. Le respect sous-tend chaque interaction, et l'intégrité façonne nos actions. Ensemble, nous sommes une équipe, unie pour servir nos clients avec un dévouement inébranlable. En tant qu'employeur responsable et solidaire, nous favorisons un milieu de travail diversifié et inclusif pour nos employés et nos candidats. Diversité, équité et inclusion sont tissés dans le tissu de notre ADN Maison, et nous nous efforçons de faire en sorte que nos employés puissent réaliser leurs aspirations personnelles et professionnelles en encourageant la mobilité interne et les programmes de perfectionnement individuel. Nous croyons fermement que la création d'équipes diversifiées contribue à nos succès et pour y parvenir, nous intégrons activement la diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion dans notre stratégie d'affaires. C'est un exci

jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

HR Finance Specialist (80-100%)

HR Finance is handling all processes related to people costs budgeting and forecasting to support the goals of the organization while ensuring a balance between revenue and costs to drive sustainable growth.

YOUR ROLE

• Manage the budgeting and forecasting process for the Unit and ensure precise HR costs monitoring as well as other aspects of HR Finance, and liaison with Group HR Finance.

• Perform payroll reconciliation processes between SAP and Workday and manages all payroll provisions to ensure accuracy and compliance.

• Manage the headcount plan, maintain and follow up on open positions and people cost, explain monthly variances (joiners, leavers, transfers), analyze trends and associated cost analysis.

• Responsible for regular HR reporting and analysis primarily in relation to headcount, people cost, Diversity, recruitment, and other HR KPI’s etc.

• Additional support to the HR team including other HR Projects, payroll, and other employee related queries.

• An active role in the compensation review cycle as well as salary benchmarking.

YOUR PROFILE

• University degree in Finance, Economics or in fields related to Business Administration.

• You have a minimum of 3-5 years’ experience in related HR Finance, Business Management, HR analytical role or Audit..

• Proven expertise in managing and processing confidential data, automating workflow processes, and overseeing database systems.

• An advanced knowledge and technical ability with MS Excel (VBA, SQL, advanced Excel a must) & and BI tools and systems (SAP, Tableau, etc.).

• A solid understanding of payroll and accounting processes is an asset.

• An ability to analyze and present data concisely.

• Project management experience would be a plus.

• Excellent problem-solving skills in constructive/realizable solution.

• Languages: French and English (both written and spoken).

• Residence in Switzerland or willingness to relocate

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote a diverse and inclusive work environment for our employees and candidates. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are woven into the fabric of our Maison’s DNA, and we strive to ensure that our employees can fulfill both their personal and professional aspirations by encouraging internal mobility and individual upskilling programs. We firmly believe that building Diverse Teams contributes to our successes and to deliver on this, we actively embed Diversity, Equity and Inclusion in our business strategy.

It is an exciting time to join our Teams. All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence.

Il tuo!
• Gestire il processo di bilancio e di previsione per l'unità e garantire un monitoraggio preciso dei costi delle risorse umane, nonché altri aspetti della HR Finance e del collegamento con il Gruppo HR Finance.
• Esegui i processi di riconciliazione del libro paga tra SAP e Workday e gestisce tutte le disposizioni del libro paga per garantire precisione e conformità.
• Gestire il piano dei conti, mantenere e seguire le posizioni aperte e le persone costano, spiegare le variazioni mensili (gioielli, lieviti, trasferimenti), analizzare le tendenze e l'analisi dei costi associati.
• Responsabile per il reporting e l’analisi delle risorse umane regolari principalmente in relazione al conteggio principale, ai costi delle persone, alla diversità, al reclutamento, ecc.
• Supporto aggiuntivo al team HR, inclusi altri progetti HR, payroll e altre domande relative ai dipendenti.
• Un ruolo attivo nel ciclo di revisione della compensazione e nel benchmarking dello stipendio. Il tuo progetto
• Laurea in finanza, economia o in settori legati alla Business Administration.
• Hai un’esperienza minima di 3-5 anni in materia di finanza HR, gestione aziendale, ruolo analitico HR o Audit..
• Prove competenze nella gestione e nell'elaborazione di dati riservati, nell'automazione dei processi di flusso di lavoro e nella supervisione dei sistemi di database.
• Una conoscenza avanzata e capacità tecnica con MS Excel (VBA, SQL, Excel avanzato a must) e strumenti e sistemi BI (SAP, Tableau, ecc.).
• Una solida comprensione del libro paga e dei processi contabili è un bene.
• Una capacità di analizzare e presentare i dati concisamente.
• L'esperienza di gestione del progetto sarebbe un vantaggio.
• Eccellente capacità di problem solving in soluzione costruttiva/realizzabile.
• Lingue: francese e inglese (sia scritto che parlato).
• Residence in Svizzera o disponibilità a trasferirsi Il DNA della nostra Maison è definito da cinque valori fondamentali. L'eccellenza ci spinge ad essere i migliori a quello che facciamo, mentre l'innovazione alimenta i nostri progressi. Il rispetto sostiene ogni interazione, e l'integrità plasma le nostre azioni. Insieme, siamo un team unico, uniti nel servire i nostri clienti con dedizione inaspettata. Come datore di lavoro responsabile e di supporto, promuoviamo un ambiente di lavoro diversificato e inclusivo per i nostri dipendenti e candidati. Diversità, equità e inclusione sono intrecciati nel tessuto del DNA della nostra Maison, e ci sforziamo di garantire che i nostri dipendenti possano soddisfare sia le loro aspirazioni personali che professionali incoraggiando la mobilità interna e programmi di upskilling individuali. Crediamo fermamente che la costruzione di Diverse Teams contribuisca ai nostri successi e a fornire su questo, abbiamo attivamente incorporato Diversità, Equità e Inclusione nella nostra strategia aziendale. E' un momento emozionante per unirsi ai nostri team. Tutte le applicazioni saranno gestite nella massima fiducia.

• L'expérience en gestion de projet serait un atout.

• Langues : français et anglais (écrit et parlé).

jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

IT Production Engineer – Scheduling / File Transfer / Monitoring (80-100%)

As part of the modernization of our IT platform and the adoption of new technologies, we are looking for a junior production engineer eager to learn and grow in areas such as Cloud, DevOps, and AI-driven automation. You will join a dynamic team of 7 engineers within the IT Operations department and contribute to the evolution of our production environment. The team is responsible for Scheduling, File Transfer and Monitoring inside IT Delivery Team

YOUR ROLE

• Operate and monitor production systems in a hybrid environment (on-premise and Cloud).

• Implement and automate workflows using DevOps practices (CI/CD pipelines, scripting).

• Participate in Cloud migration projects and help define best practices.

• Contribute to AI-based initiatives for predictive monitoring and process optimization.

• Provide Level 2/3 support for production incidents and collaborate with technical teams.

• Document processes and propose improvements for reliability and efficiency.

• Internal Contacts: Production team (Product-Support, Exploitation), Integration team, Infrastructure teams (Databases, Systems, Networks), Development teams, Service Management teams (Incidents and Problems)

• External Contacts: Cloud service providers, Technology partners, and vendors

YOUR PROFILE

• Degree in Computer Science or equivalent.

• Zero to 3-4 years of experience in a similar role

• Knowledge of Cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP).

• Knowledge of DevOps tools (Git, Jenkins/GitLab CI, Docker, Kubernetes).

• Knowledge of scripting (Python, Bash) and interest in automation.

• Curiosity about AI technologies and their application in IT operations.

• Good analytical skills, willingness to learn, and team spirit.

• Fluent in French and English (spoken and written).

• Residence in Switzerland or willingness to relocate.

TECHNICAL ENVIRONMENT

• Cloud: Azure

• DevOps: Git, AzureDevOps CI/CD, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes

• Automation & Scripting: Opcon, GoAnyhere, Python, Bash, PowerShell

• Monitoring & Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, ServiceNow Event Management

• AI & Analytics: APIs for predictive monitoring, anomaly detection tools

• Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, Ansible

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote a diverse and inclusive work environment for our employees and candidates. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are woven into the fabric of our Maison’s DNA, and we strive to ensure that our employees can fulfill both their personal and professional aspirations by encouraging internal mobility and individual upskilling programs. Con una storia di oltre 230 anni, Lombard Odier è una casa di investimento che offre un'offerta completa di gestione del portafoglio discrezionale e consultivo, servizi di ricchezza e custodia. Offriamo anche servizi di asset management e strategie di investimento attraverso Lombard Odier Investment Manager e fornire tecnologia bancaria avanzata ad altre istituzioni finanziarie. “Rethink Everything” è la nostra filosofia – è al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo. Siamo cresciuti più forti attraverso più di 40 crisi finanziarie ripensando il mondo intorno a noi per fornire una nuova prospettiva di investimento per i nostri clienti. IT Production Engineer – Scheduling / Trasferimento file / Monitoraggio (80-100%) Nell'ambito della modernizzazione della nostra piattaforma IT e dell'adozione di nuove tecnologie, stiamo cercando un ingegnere di produzione junior desideroso di imparare e crescere in aree come Cloud, DevOps e l'automazione AI-driven. Ti unirai a un team dinamico di 7 ingegneri all'interno del reparto IT Operations e contribuirai all'evoluzione del nostro ambiente di produzione. Il team è responsabile di Scheduling, File Transfer e Monitoraggio all'interno del team IT Delivery Il tuo!
• Operare e monitorare i sistemi di produzione in un ambiente ibrido (on-premise e Cloud).
• Implementare e automatizzare i flussi di lavoro utilizzando le pratiche DevOps (condutture CI/CD, scripting).
• Partecipare a progetti di migrazione cloud e contribuire a definire le migliori pratiche.
• Contribuire a iniziative basate su AI per il monitoraggio predittivo e l'ottimizzazione dei processi.
• Fornire il supporto di Livello 2/3 per gli incidenti di produzione e collaborare con i team tecnici.
• Processi di documenti e proposte di miglioramenti per affidabilità ed efficienza.
• Contatti interni: team di produzione (Product-Support, Exploitation), team di integrazione, team di infrastruttura (Databases, Systems, Networks), team di sviluppo, team di Service Management (Incidenti e Problemi)
• Contatti esterni: fornitori di servizi cloud, partner tecnologici e fornitori Il tuo progetto
• Laurea in Informatica o equivalente.
• Da zero a 3-4 anni di esperienza in un ruolo simile
• Conoscenza delle piattaforme Cloud (Azure, AWS o GCP).
• Conoscenza degli strumenti DevOps (Git, Jenkins/GitLab CI, Docker, Kubernetes).
• Conoscenza della scrittura (Python, Bash) e interesse per l'automazione.
• Curiosità sulle tecnologie AI e la loro applicazione nelle operazioni IT.
• Buone capacità analitiche, disponibilità ad imparare e spirito di squadra.
• Fluente in francese e inglese (spoken e scritto).
• Residence in Svizzera o disponibilità a trasferirsi. AMBIENTE TECNICO
• Cloud: Azure
• DevOps: Git, AzureDevOps CI/CD, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes
• Automazione e scrittura: Opcon, GoAnyhere, Python, Bash, PowerShell
• Monitoraggio e osservabilità: Prometeo, Grafana, ServiceNow Gestione eventi
• AI & Analytics: API per il monitoraggio predittivo, strumenti di rilevamento di anomalie
• Infrastrutture come Codice: Terraform, Ansible Il DNA della nostra Maison è definito da cinque valori fondamentali. L'eccellenza ci spinge ad essere i migliori a quello che facciamo, mentre l'innovazione alimenta i nostri progressi. Il rispetto sostiene ogni interazione, e l'integrità plasma le nostre azioni. Insieme, siamo un team unico, uniti nel servire i nostri clienti con dedizione inaspettata. Come datore di lavoro responsabile e di supporto, promuoviamo un ambiente di lavoro diversificato e inclusivo per i nostri dipendenti e candidati. Diversità, equità e inclusione sono intrecciati nel tessuto del DNA della nostra Maison, e ci sforziamo di garantire che i nostri dipendenti possano soddisfare sia le loro aspirazioni personali che professionali incoraggiando la mobilità interna e programmi di upskilling individuali. Wir sind durch mehr als 40 Finanzkrisen stärker gewachsen, indem wir die Welt um uns herum neu denken, um unseren Kunden eine neue Investitionsperspektive zu bieten. IT-Produktionsingenieur – Scheduling / Dateiübertragung / Monitoring (80-100%) Im Rahmen der Modernisierung unserer IT-Plattform und der Einführung neuer Technologien suchen wir einen Nachwuchsingenieur, der in Bereichen wie Cloud, DevOps und AI-getriebene Automation lernen und wachsen kann. Sie werden ein dynamisches Team von 7 Ingenieuren in der IT-Betriebsabteilung beitreten und zur Entwicklung unserer Produktionsumgebung beitragen. Das Team ist verantwortlich für Scheduling, File Transfer und Monitoring im IT Delivery Team IHRE ROLLE
• Produktionssysteme in einer hybriden Umgebung (on-premise und Cloud) betreiben und überwachen.
• Implementierung und Automatisierung von Workflows mittels DevOps-Praktiken (CI/CD-Pipeline, Skripting).

• Mithilfe von AI-basierten Initiativen zur vorausschauenden Überwachung und Prozessoptimierung.

• Dokumentenprozesse und Verbesserungen für Zuverlässigkeit und Effizienz.

• Externe Kontakte: Cloud-Dienstleister, Technologiepartner und Anbieter IHRE PROFILE
• Grad in Informatik oder gleichwertig.
• Zero bis 3-4 Jahre Erfahrung in einer ähnlichen Rolle
• Kenntnis von Cloud-Plattformen (Azure, AWS oder GCP).
• Kenntnisse der DevOps-Werkzeuge (Git, Jenkins/GitLab CI, Docker, Kubernetes).
• Wissen über Skripting (Python, Bash) und Interesse an Automatisierung.
• Curiosität über KI-Technologien und ihre Anwendung im IT-Betrieb.
• Gute analytische Fähigkeiten, Lernbereitschaft und Teamgeist.
• Flöten in Französisch und Englisch (gesprochen und geschrieben).
• Aufenthalt in der Schweiz oder Verlagerungsbereitschaft. TECHNISCHE UMWELT
• Cloud: Azure
• DevOps: Git, AzureDevOps CI/CD, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes
• Automation & Scripting: Opcon, GoAnyhere, Python, Bash, PowerShell
• Monitoring und Beobachtung: Prometheus, Grafana, ServiceNow Event Management
• AI & Analytics: APIs zur vorausschauenden Überwachung, Anomalienerkennungstools

jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Settlement Specialist (12-month contract) (80–100%)

The Settlement Specialist is responsible for ensuring the successful and timely settlement of transactions. They monitor and reconcile failing trades.
A strong understanding of trading operations and excellent communication skills are essential for effective operational management.

YOUR ROLE

• Daily monitoring of pending transactions through to final settlement.

• Analysis and management of complex transactions and exceptional situations.

• Identification of recurring changes in settlement instructions; request corrections/creation of networks (SSI) to maximize automation.

• Propose solutions to increase operational efficiency and optimize processes.

• Coordinate and verify incoming/outgoing payments for exceptions (e.g., netting).

• Daily collaboration and communication with clients, custodians, and internal teams to resolve settlement issues.

• Perform daily reconciliation of cash and securities positions, resolve breaks, and ensure proper traceability with consistent commentary.

• Ensure compliance with financial regulations and internal policies regarding Delivery versus Payment (DvP) and Free of Payment (FoP/Lending).

• Adhere to regulatory requirements and company/group policies.

• Identify and mitigate operational risks and review procedures.

YOUR PROFILE

• Bachelor’s degree in finance or equivalent in business administration. Swiss banking apprenticeship (CFC Banque) / Professional Banking Maturity also considered.

• Strong knowledge of SWIFT ISO 20022 (particularly MT54x messages), regulatory requirements, and custodian platforms.

• Good knowledge of financial instruments (bonds, equities, etc.).

• Experience in other back- or middle-office functions is a plus.

• Strong team spirit and ability to build solid professional relationships.

• Ability to work under pressure, meet tight deadlines, and manage priorities effectively.

• Ability to challenge existing processes and propose improvements.

• Fluency in French and English (minimum B2 level); German is an asset.

• Residence in Switzerland or willingness to relocate.

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote a diverse and inclusive work environment for our employees and candidates. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are woven into the fabric of our Maison’s DNA, and we strive to ensure that our employees can fulfill both their personal and professional aspirations by encouraging internal mobility and individual upskilling programs. We firmly believe that building Diverse Teams contributes to our successes and to deliver on this, we actively embed Diversity, Equity and Inclusion in our business strategy.

It is an exciting ti

descriptionByLocale.it:
Una carriera a Lombard Odier significa lavorare per un rinomato asset manager globale, con un forte focus sugli investimenti sostenibili. Un'innovativa banca di scelta per clienti privati e istituzionali, il nostro Studio indipendente di proprietà è uno dei gruppi bancari più capitalizzati al mondo, che gestisce quasi 300 miliardi di franchi e opera da oltre 25 uffici in 4 continenti. Con una storia di oltre 230 anni, Lombard Odier è una casa di investimento che offre un'offerta completa di gestione del portafoglio discrezionale e consultivo, servizi di ricchezza e custodia. Offriamo anche servizi di asset management e strategie di investimento attraverso Lombard Odier Investment Manager e fornire tecnologia bancaria avanzata ad altre istituzioni finanziarie. “Rethink Everything” è la nostra filosofia – è al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo. Siamo cresciuti più forti attraverso più di 40 crisi finanziarie ripensando il mondo intorno a noi per fornire una nuova prospettiva di investimento per i nostri clienti. Settlement Specialist (12 mesi) (80-100%) Il Settlement Specialist è responsabile di garantire il successo e tempestivo insediamento delle transazioni. Monitorano e riconciliano gli scambi falliti. Una forte comprensione delle operazioni di trading e eccellenti capacità di comunicazione sono essenziali per una gestione operativa efficace. Il tuo!
• Monitoraggio giornaliero delle operazioni in sospeso attraverso il regolamento finale.
• Analisi e gestione di operazioni complesse e situazioni eccezionali.
• Identificazione dei cambiamenti ricorrenti nelle istruzioni di regolamento; richiesta di correzioni/creazione di reti (SSI) per massimizzare l'automazione.
• Proporre soluzioni per aumentare l'efficienza operativa e ottimizzare i processi.
• Coordinare e verificare i pagamenti in entrata/uscita per le eccezioni (ad esempio, netting).
• Collaborazione quotidiana e comunicazione con clienti, custodi e team interni per risolvere i problemi di regolamento.
• Eseguire la riconciliazione quotidiana di posizioni in denaro e titoli, risolvere le pause e garantire una corretta tracciabilità con commento coerente.
• Assicurare la conformità alle normative finanziarie e alle politiche interne in materia di Consegna contro Pagamento (DvP) e Free of Payment (FoP/Lending).
• Seguire i requisiti normativi e le politiche aziendali/gruppo.
• Identificare e mitigare i rischi operativi e le procedure di revisione. Il tuo progetto
• Laurea in finanza o equivalente in amministrazione aziendale. Apprendistato bancario svizzero (CFC Banque) / Professional Banking Maturity anche considerato.
• Forte conoscenza di SWIFT ISO 20022 (in particolare messaggi MT54x), requisiti normativi e piattaforme di custodia.
• Buona conoscenza degli strumenti finanziari (bond, equità, ecc.).
• L'esperienza in altre funzioni back-o middle-office è un plus.
• Forte spirito di squadra e capacità di costruire relazioni professionali solide.
• Capacità di lavorare sotto pressione, rispettare scadenze strette e gestire le priorità in modo efficace.
• Capacità di sfidare i processi esistenti e proporre miglioramenti.
• Fluenza in francese e inglese (livello minimo B2); il tedesco è un bene.
• Residence in Svizzera o disponibilità a trasferirsi. Il DNA della nostra Maison è definito da cinque valori fondamentali. L'eccellenza ci spinge ad essere i migliori a quello che facciamo, mentre l'innovazione alimenta i nostri progressi. Il rispetto sostiene ogni interazione, e l'integrità plasma le nostre azioni. Insieme, siamo un team unico, uniti nel servire i nostri clienti con dedizione inaspettata. Come datore di lavoro responsabile e di supporto, promuoviamo un ambiente di lavoro diversificato e inclusivo per i nostri dipendenti e candidati. Diversità, equità e inclusione sono intrecciati nel tessuto del DNA della nostra Maison, e ci sforziamo di garantire che i nostri dipendenti possano soddisfare sia le loro aspirazioni personali che professionali incoraggiando la mobilità interna e programmi di upskilling individuali. Crediamo fermamente che la costruzione di Diverse Teams contribuisca ai nostri successi e a fornire su questo, abbiamo attivamente incorporato Diversità, Equità e Inclusione nella nostra strategia aziendale. È un ti eccitante

Eine Karriere bei Lombard Odier bedeutet, für einen renommierten globalen Vermögens- und Vermögensverwalter mit einem starken Fokus auf nachhaltige Investitionen zu arbeiten. Eine innovative Bank der Wahl für private und institutionelle Kunden, unser unabhängiger Eigentümer Firm ist eine der besten Bankengruppen der Welt, die in der Nähe von CHF 300 Milliarden verwaltet und von über 25 Büros auf 4 Kontinenten. Lombard Odier ist mit einer über 230-jährigen Geschichte ein Investmenthaus, das ein umfassendes Angebot an diskreten und beratenden Portfolio-Management, Vermögensdienstleistungen und Sorge bietet. Wir bieten auch Asset-Management-Dienste und Anlagestrategien durch Lombard Odier Investment Manager und bieten fortschrittliche Banktechnologie an andere Finanzinstitute. „Rethink Everything“ ist unsere Philosophie – es liegt im Herzen von allem, was wir tun. Wir sind durch mehr als 40 Finanzkrisen stärker gewachsen, indem wir die Welt um uns herum neu denken, um unseren Kunden eine neue Investitionsperspektive zu bieten. Abwicklungsspezialist (12-Monatsvertrag) (80–100%) Der Settlement-Spezialist ist für die erfolgreiche und rechtzeitige Abwicklung von Transaktionen verantwortlich. Ein starkes Verständnis von Handelsgeschäften und exzellenten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten sind für ein effektives operatives Management unerlässlich. IHRE ROLLE

• Analyse und Verwaltung komplexer Transaktionen und außergewöhnlicher Situationen.

• Lösungen zur Steigerung der Betriebseffizienz und zur Optimierung von Prozessen.
• Für Ausnahmen (z.B. Netting) koordinieren und die eingehenden/ausgehenden Zahlungen überprüfen.
• Tägliche Zusammenarbeit und Kommunikation mit Kunden, Kunden und internen Teams zur Lösung von Siedlungsproblemen.
• Führen Sie die tägliche Aussöhnung von Bargeld und Wertpapierpositionen durch, lösen Sie Pausen und sorgen Sie für eine ordnungsgemäße Rückverfolgbarkeit mit konsequentem Kommentar.
• Gewährleistung der Einhaltung von Finanzvorschriften und internen Richtlinien zur Lieferung gegen Zahlung (DvP) und kostenloser Bezahlung (FoP/Lending).
• Einhaltung regulatorischer Anforderungen und Unternehmens- und Gruppenrichtlinien.
• Ermittlung und Minderung der operationellen Risiken und Überprüfungsverfahren. IHRE PROFILE
• Bachelor-Abschluss in Finanzen oder gleichwertig in der Betriebswirtschaft. Auch die Schweizer Bankenlehre (CFC Banque) / Professional Banking Maturity wurde berücksichtigt.
• Starke Kenntnisse der SWIFT ISO 20022 (insbesondere MT54x-Nachrichten), regulatorische Anforderungen und custodian Plattformen.
• Gute Kenntnis der Finanzinstrumente (Anleihen, Aktien usw.).
• Erfahrung in anderen Back- oder Middle-Office-Funktionen ist ein Plus.
• Starker Teamgeist und die Fähigkeit, solide professionelle Beziehungen aufzubauen.
• Fähigkeit, unter Druck zu arbeiten, enge Fristen zu erfüllen und Prioritäten effektiv zu verwalten.
• Fähigkeit, bestehende Prozesse herauszufordern und Verbesserungen vorzuschlagen.
• Fluency in Französisch und Englisch (mindestens B2 Ebene); Deutsch ist ein Vermögenswert.

Une carrière chez Lombard Odier signifie travailler pour un gérant mondial de patrimoine et d'actifs renommé, avec un accent fort sur l'investissement durable. Banque innovante de choix pour les clients privés et institutionnels, notre entreprise indépendante est l'un des groupes bancaires les mieux capitalisés au monde, gérant près de CHF 300 milliards et opérant depuis plus de 25 bureaux sur 4 continents. Avec une histoire de plus de 230 ans, Lombard Odier est une maison d'investissement offrant une offre complète de gestion de portefeuille discrétionnaire et consultative, de services de patrimoine et de garde. Nous offrons également des services de gestion d'actifs et des stratégies d'investissement par l'intermédiaire de Lombard Odier Investment Managers et fournissons une technologie bancaire avancée à d'autres institutions financières. Repensez Tout est notre philosophie – elle est au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. Nous sommes devenus plus forts grâce à plus de 40 crises financières en repensant le monde qui nous entoure pour offrir une nouvelle perspective d'investissement à nos clients. Spécialiste de l'établissement (contrat de 12 mois) (80 à 100 %) Le spécialiste du règlement est chargé d'assurer le règlement des opérations en temps opportun. Ils surveillent et réconcilient les métiers défaillants. Une bonne compréhension des opérations commerciales et d'excellentes compétences en communication sont essentielles pour une gestion opérationnelle efficace. Votre rôle
• Contrôle quotidien des opérations en cours jusqu'au règlement final.
• Analyse et gestion de transactions complexes et de situations exceptionnelles.
• Identification des changements récurrents dans les instructions de règlement; demande de corrections/création de réseaux (SSI) pour maximiser l'automatisation.
• Proposer des solutions pour accroître l'efficacité opérationnelle et optimiser les processus.
• Coordonner et vérifier les paiements entrants/sorties pour les exceptions (par exemple, compensation).
• Collaboration et communication quotidiennes avec les clients, les gardiens et les équipes internes pour résoudre les problèmes de règlement.
• Effectuer un rapprochement quotidien des positions de trésorerie et de valeurs mobilières, résoudre les ruptures et assurer une traçabilité adéquate avec des commentaires cohérents.
• Assurer le respect des règlements financiers et des politiques internes en matière de livraison par rapport au paiement (DvP) et sans paiement (FoP/Lending).
• Adhérer aux exigences réglementaires et aux politiques d'entreprise/groupe.
• Identifier et atténuer les risques opérationnels et les procédures d'examen. VOTRE PROFIL
• Baccalauréat en finance ou équivalent en administration des affaires. Apprentissage bancaire suisse (CFC Banque) / Professional Banking Maturity également considéré.
• Bonne connaissance de SWIFT ISO 20022 (en particulier les messages MT54x), des exigences réglementaires et des plateformes de garde.
• Bonne connaissance des instruments financiers (obligations, actions, etc.).
• L'expérience dans d'autres fonctions back- ou intermédiaire est un plus.
• L'esprit d'équipe et la capacité d'établir des relations professionnelles solides.
• Capacité de travailler sous pression, de respecter des délais serrés et de gérer efficacement les priorités.
• Capacité de remettre en question les processus existants et de proposer des améliorations.
• La maîtrise du français et de l'anglais (niveau minimum B2) ; l'allemand est un atout.
• Résidence en Suisse ou volonté de déménager. L'ADN de la Maison est défini par cinq valeurs fondamentales. L'excellence nous pousse à être les meilleurs dans ce que nous faisons, tandis que l'innovation alimente nos progrès. Le respect sous-tend chaque interaction, et l'intégrité façonne nos actions. Ensemble, nous sommes une équipe, unie pour servir nos clients avec un dévouement inébranlable. En tant qu'employeur responsable et solidaire, nous favorisons un milieu de travail diversifié et inclusif pour nos employés et nos candidats. Diversité, équité et inclusion sont tissés dans le tissu de notre ADN Maison, et nous nous efforçons de faire en sorte que nos employés puissent réaliser leurs aspirations personnelles et professionnelles en encourageant la mobilité interne et les programmes de perfectionnement individuel. Nous croyons fermement que la création d'équipes diversifiées contribue à nos succès et pour y parvenir, nous intégrons activement la diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion dans notre stratégie d'affaires. C'est excitant

jobs.title: SAP FI Application Expert (80-100%)
jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

SAP FI Application Expert (80-100%)

Within our IT Department, you will join a team of experts responsible for the evolution of our financial ecosystem. In a Private Banking environment where data precision and availability are critical, you will play a key role within a scope covering accounting, business intelligence, planning and consolidation, and expense management. Your mission will be threefold:

• Ensure operational continuity through second and third-level support,

• Steer the evolution of the platform in close collaboration with the SAP product owner, and Finance stakeholders,

• Contribute to cross-functional project delivery.

You will also participate to our technological transition toward next-generation solutions (S/4HANA).

YOUR ROLE

Product Evolution & Project Delivery:

• Gather and analyze business requirements from Finance and Controlling teams.

• Design functional solutions and write specifications

• Contribute to BPC planning model evolution and BW/4, SAP Analytics Cloud reporting developments

• S/4HANA Transformation: Actively contribute to S/4 Hana conversion projects and new onboarding projects.

• Manage end-to-end delivery of change requests and projects (scoping, testing, training, go-live).

• Configure SAP FI (GL, AR, AP, Asset Accounting) and CO modules.

• Ensure all changes comply with internal change management and audit frameworks.

Application support & maintenance:

• Provide Level 2 / Level 3 functional and technical support for SAP FI/CO, BW/4 Hana, SAC, BPC and Concur.

• Investigate, diagnose and resolve incidents within agreed SLAs; escalate to SAP when required.

• Monitor batch jobs, interfaces and data flows; ensure system health and data integrity.

• Manage transports, patches and corrections across the landscape.

• Maintain functional and technical documentation up to date after every change.

YOUR PROFILE

• Minimum 7 years of hands-on SAP FI (80%) / CO (20%) experience in a complex, regulated environment (functional & technical expertise)

• Proven track record in both support/run activities and project mode

• Good command of SAP BW reporting, BPC planning & consolidation, and SAP Concur configuration and integration with SAP FI

• Knowledge or experience on S/4HANA architecture and migration concepts will be appreciated

• Solid understanding of financial accounting processes: general ledger, accounts payable/receivable, asset management, bank reconciliation

• Familiarity with private banking operational flows (client accounting, fees, treasury, regulatory reporting) is a plus

• Strong analytical mindset with ability to translate complex functional requirements into technical solutions

• Excellent communication skills – able to present to both technical and business audiences

• Rigorous, autonomous and structured; comfortable managing several tasks and priorities simultaneously

• Collaborative team player with a service-oriented attitude

• Full proficiency in French and English

• Residence

descriptionByLocale.it:
Una carriera a Lombard Odier significa lavorare per un rinomato asset manager globale, con un forte focus sugli investimenti sostenibili. Un'innovativa banca di scelta per clienti privati e istituzionali, il nostro Studio indipendente di proprietà è uno dei gruppi bancari più capitalizzati al mondo, che gestisce quasi 300 miliardi di franchi e opera da oltre 25 uffici in 4 continenti. Con una storia di oltre 230 anni, Lombard Odier è una casa di investimento che offre un'offerta completa di gestione del portafoglio discrezionale e consultivo, servizi di ricchezza e custodia. Offriamo anche servizi di asset management e strategie di investimento attraverso Lombard Odier Investment Manager e fornire tecnologia bancaria avanzata ad altre istituzioni finanziarie. “Rethink Everything” è la nostra filosofia – è al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo. Siamo cresciuti più forti attraverso più di 40 crisi finanziarie ripensando il mondo intorno a noi per fornire una nuova prospettiva di investimento per i nostri clienti. SAP FI Application Expert (80-100%) All'interno del nostro reparto IT, si unirà a un team di esperti responsabili dell'evoluzione del nostro ecosistema finanziario. In un ambiente Private Banking dove la precisione e la disponibilità dei dati sono fondamentali, si svolgerà un ruolo chiave all'interno di un ambito di contabilità, business intelligence, pianificazione e consolidamento e gestione delle spese. La vostra missione sarà triplice:
• Assicurare la continuità operativa attraverso il supporto di secondo e terzo livello,
• Promuovere l'evoluzione della piattaforma in stretta collaborazione con il proprietario del prodotto SAP e con gli stakeholder Finance,
• Contribuire alla consegna del progetto interfunzionale. Parteciperai anche alla nostra transizione tecnologica verso soluzioni di nuova generazione (S/4HANA). Il tuo! Prodotto Evolution & Project Delivery:
• Raccogliere e analizzare i requisiti aziendali dai team Finance e Controlling.
• Progettazione di soluzioni funzionali e specifiche di scrittura
• Contribuire all'evoluzione del modello di pianificazione BPC e a BW/4, SAP Analytics Cloud
• S/4HANA Transformation: contribuisce attivamente ai progetti di conversione S/4 Hana e ai nuovi progetti di imbarco.
• Gestire la consegna end-to-end di richieste di cambiamento e progetti (scoping, test, formazione, go-live).
• Configurare i moduli SAP FI (GL, AR, AP, Asset Accounting) e CO.
• Assicurarsi che tutte le modifiche siano conformi ai quadri interni di gestione dei cambiamenti e audit. Supporto per applicazioni e manutenzione:
• Fornire il supporto tecnico e funzionale al livello 3 per SAP FI/CO, BW/4 Hana, SAC, BPC e Concur.
• Indagare, diagnosticare e risolvere gli incidenti all'interno di SLA concordati; escalare a SAP quando necessario.
• Monitorare lavori in batch, interfacce e flussi di dati; garantire la salute del sistema e l'integrità dei dati.
• Gestire trasporti, patch e correzioni attraverso il paesaggio.
• Mantenere documentazione funzionale e tecnica fino ad oggi dopo ogni cambiamento. Il tuo progetto
• Minimo 7 anni di esperienza SAP FI (80%) / CO (20%) in un ambiente complesso e regolamentato (esperienza funzionale e tecnica)
• Provato record di traccia in attività di supporto/esecuzione e modalità progetto
• Buon comando del reporting SAP BW, della pianificazione e del consolidamento BPC e della configurazione e integrazione SAP Concur con SAP FI
• La conoscenza o l'esperienza sui concetti di architettura e migrazione S/4HANA saranno apprezzati
• Comprensione solida dei processi contabili finanziari: registro generale, contabilità pagabile/ricevibile, gestione patrimoniale, riconciliazione bancaria
• La familiarità con i flussi operativi bancari privati (contabilità clienti, commissioni, tesoreria, reporting normativo) è un plus
• Forte mentalità analitica con capacità di tradurre complessi requisiti funzionali in soluzioni tecniche
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione – in grado di presentare al pubblico sia tecnico che commerciale
• Rigoroso, autonomo e strutturato; gestione confortevole di più compiti e priorità contemporaneamente
• Giocatore di squadra collaborativo con un atteggiamento orientato al servizio
• Competenza completa in francese e inglese
• Residence

Eine Karriere bei Lombard Odier bedeutet, für einen renommierten globalen Vermögens- und Vermögensverwalter mit einem starken Fokus auf nachhaltige Investitionen zu arbeiten. Eine innovative Bank der Wahl für private und institutionelle Kunden, unser unabhängiger Eigentümer Firm ist eine der besten Bankengruppen der Welt, die in der Nähe von CHF 300 Milliarden verwaltet und von über 25 Büros auf 4 Kontinenten. Lombard Odier ist mit einer über 230-jährigen Geschichte ein Investmenthaus, das ein umfassendes Angebot an diskreten und beratenden Portfolio-Management, Vermögensdienstleistungen und Sorge bietet. Wir bieten auch Asset-Management-Dienste und Anlagestrategien durch Lombard Odier Investment Manager und bieten fortschrittliche Banktechnologie an andere Finanzinstitute. „Rethink Everything“ ist unsere Philosophie – es liegt im Herzen von allem, was wir tun. Wir sind durch mehr als 40 Finanzkrisen stärker gewachsen, indem wir die Welt um uns herum neu denken, um unseren Kunden eine neue Investitionsperspektive zu bieten. SAP FI Application Expert (80-100%) In unserer IT-Abteilung werden Sie sich einem Expertenteam anschließen, das für die Entwicklung unseres Finanzsystems verantwortlich ist. In einer Private Banking-Umgebung, in der die Datenpräzision und Verfügbarkeit kritisch sind, werden Sie eine Schlüsselrolle in einem Bereich spielen, der Rechnungswesen, Business Intelligence, Planung und Konsolidierung und Kostenmanagement umfasst. Ihre Mission wird dreifach sein:
• Sicherstellung der operativen Kontinuität durch Unterstützung auf zweiter und dritter Ebene;
• Die Entwicklung der Plattform in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem SAP-Produkthalter und den Interessenvertretern der Finanzen steuern;
• Beitrag zur funktionsübergreifenden Projektauslieferung. Sie werden auch an unserem technologischen Übergang zu Lösungen der nächsten Generation teilnehmen (S/4HANA). IHRE ROLLE Produkt Evolution & Projekt Lieferung:
• Unternehmensanforderungen von Finanz- und Controlling-Teams sammeln und analysieren.
• Design funktionale Lösungen und Schreibspezifikationen
• BPC-Planungsmodellentwicklung und BW/4, SAP Analytics Cloud-Reporting-Entwicklungen
• S/4HANA Transformation: Aktiver Beitrag zu S/4 Hana Conversion-Projekten und neuen Onboarding-Projekten.
• Verwalten Sie die End-to-End-Lieferung von Änderungsanfragen und -projekten (Scoping, Testing, Training, Go-live).
• Konfigurieren von SAP FI (GL, AR, AP, Asset Accounting) und CO-Modulen.
• Stellen Sie sicher, dass alle Änderungen den internen Change Management- und Audit-Frameworks entsprechen. Anwendungsunterstützung und Wartung:
• Bereitstellung von Level 2 / Level 3 funktionale und technische Unterstützung für SAP FI/CO, BW/4 Hana, SAC, BPC und Concur.
• Untersuchung, Diagnose und Lösung von Vorfällen innerhalb vereinbarter SLAs; eskalieren Sie auf SAP, wenn erforderlich.
• Überwachung von Batch-Jobs, Schnittstellen und Datenflüssen; Gewährleistung der Systemgesundheit und Datenintegrität.
• Transporte, Patches und Korrekturen in der gesamten Landschaft verwalten.
• Bewahren Sie funktionale und technische Dokumentation nach jeder Änderung auf dem neuesten Stand. IHRE PROFILE
• Mindestens 7 Jahre Hand-on SAP FI (80%) / CO (20%) Erfahrung in einer komplexen, geregelten Umgebung (funktional & technische Expertise)
• Bewährte Erfolgsbilanz sowohl im Support- als auch im Projektmodus
• Guter Befehl von SAP BW Reporting, BPC-Planung & Konsolidierung und SAP Concur Konfiguration und Integration mit SAP FI
• Wissen oder Erfahrung über S/4HANA Architektur- und Migrationskonzepte werden geschätzt
• Solides Verständnis der Finanzbuchhaltungsprozesse: allgemeine Führung, fällige/empfangbare Konten, Vermögensverwaltung, Bankversöhnung
• Vertraulichkeit mit privaten Bankgeschäftsflüssen (Client Accounting, Gebühren, Treasury, regulatorische Berichterstattung) ist ein Plus
• Starke analytische Denkweise mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Funktionsanforderungen in technische Lösungen umzusetzen
• Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten – in der Lage, sowohl technischen als auch geschäftlichen Publikum
• Robust, autonom und strukturiert; komfortable Verwaltung mehrerer Aufgaben und Prioritäten gleichzeitig
• Mitarbeiter mit einer serviceorientierten Einstellung
• Vollständige Sprachkenntnisse in Französisch und Englisch
• Ferienwohnung
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Une carrière chez Lombard Odier signifie travailler pour un gérant mondial de patrimoine et d'actifs renommé, avec un accent fort sur l'investissement durable. Banque innovante de choix pour les clients privés et institutionnels, notre entreprise indépendante est l'un des groupes bancaires les mieux capitalisés au monde, gérant près de CHF 300 milliards et opérant depuis plus de 25 bureaux sur 4 continents. Avec une histoire de plus de 230 ans, Lombard Odier est une maison d'investissement offrant une offre complète de gestion de portefeuille discrétionnaire et consultative, de services de patrimoine et de garde. Nous offrons également des services de gestion d'actifs et des stratégies d'investissement par l'intermédiaire de Lombard Odier Investment Managers et fournissons une technologie bancaire avancée à d'autres institutions financières. Repensez Tout est notre philosophie – elle est au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. Nous sommes devenus plus forts grâce à plus de 40 crises financières en repensant le monde qui nous entoure pour offrir une nouvelle perspective d'investissement à nos clients. Expert en applications SAP FI (80-100%) Au sein de notre département informatique, vous rejoindrez une équipe d'experts responsables de l'évolution de notre écosystème financier. Dans un environnement de banque privée où la précision et la disponibilité des données sont essentielles, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le domaine de la comptabilité, des renseignements commerciaux, de la planification et de la consolidation, et de la gestion des dépenses. Votre mission sera triple :
• Assurer la continuité opérationnelle grâce à l'appui des deuxième et troisième niveaux;
• suivre l'évolution de la plateforme en étroite collaboration avec le propriétaire du produit SAP et les parties prenantes financières,
• Contribuer à la réalisation de projets interfonctionnels. Vous participerez également à notre transition technologique vers des solutions de nouvelle génération (S/4HANA). Votre rôle Évolution du produit et livraison du projet :
• Recueillir et analyser les besoins opérationnels des équipes de finance et de contrôle.
• Concevoir des solutions fonctionnelles et des spécifications écrites
• Contribuer à l'évolution du modèle de planification de BPC et BW/4, développements de reporting SAP Analytics Cloud
• S/4HANA Transformation : contribuer activement aux projets de conversion S/4 Hana et aux nouveaux projets embarqués.
• Gérer l'exécution de bout en bout des demandes et des projets de changement (couverture, mise à l'essai, formation, mise en oeuvre).
• Configurer les modules SAP FI (GL, AR, AP, Asset Accounting) et CO.
• Veiller à ce que tous les changements soient conformes aux cadres internes de gestion du changement et d'audit. Support et entretien de l'application :
• Fournir un soutien fonctionnel et technique de niveau 2 / niveau 3 pour SAP FI/CO, BW/4 Hana, SAC, BPC et Concur.
• Enquêter, diagnostiquer et résoudre les incidents dans le cadre des ALS convenus; passer au SAP au besoin.
• Surveiller les tâches, les interfaces et les flux de données par lots; assurer la santé et l'intégrité des données du système.
• Gérer les transports, les correctifs et les corrections à travers le paysage.
• Tenir à jour la documentation fonctionnelle et technique après chaque changement. VOTRE PROFIL
• Au moins 7 ans d'expérience pratique SAP FI (80 %) / CO (20 %) dans un environnement complexe et réglementé (expertise fonctionnelle et technique)
• Expérience éprouvée tant dans les activités de soutien/exécution que dans le mode projet
• Bonne maîtrise du reporting SAP BW, de la planification et de la consolidation BPC, et de la configuration et de l'intégration SAP Concur avec SAP FI
• Les connaissances ou l'expérience sur l'architecture et les concepts de migration S/4HANA seront appréciées
• Une bonne compréhension des processus de comptabilité financière : grand livre, comptes créditeurs/recettes, gestion des actifs, rapprochement des comptes bancaires
• Familiarisation avec les flux opérationnels des banques privées (comptabilité client, honoraires, trésorerie, rapports réglementaires) est un plus
• Un état d'esprit analytique fort capable de traduire des exigences fonctionnelles complexes en solutions techniques
• Excellentes compétences en communication – capables de présenter aux publics techniques et commerciaux
• Rigieuse, autonome et structurée; gestion confortable de plusieurs tâches et priorités simultanément
• Collaborateur avec une attitude axée sur le service
• Compréhension complète en français et en anglais
• Résidence

jobs.title: Systems Engineer – Automation (Windows/VMware)
jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Systems Engineer – Automation (Windows/VMware)

We are looking for a Windows Systems Engineer with a strong passion for automation and infrastructure optimization. You will join a dynamic team of 15 system engineering experts who manage a global infrastructure of more than 7,000 servers. This is a large-scale technical environment where expertise, innovation and advanced automation are at the core of our mission.
You will play a key role in the evolution and standardization of our IT landscape, with a strong focus on PowerShell, VMware Aria/vRealize Automation, and Windows technologies such as Windows Server and Active Directory.
You will be involved in the design, implementation and maintenance of automation solutions aimed at improving operational efficiency and reducing manual intervention.
We actively encourage innovation and the proposal of new ideas to enhance our platforms.
We are currently driving several strategic initiatives, including the upgrade to VMware Cloud Foundation 9 (VCF 9) to modernize our virtualization stack, as well as a next generation observability project based on Elastic solutions.

YOUR ROLE

• Design, develop and maintain advanced PowerShell scripts to automate system administration tasks.

• Deploy, maintain, and optimize VMware Aria / vRealize Automation workflows and blueprints.

• Participate in the administration and evolution of Windows platforms, including Windows Server, Active Directory / ADFS / GPO, SCCM (Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager).

• Contribute to the adoption of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices.

• Ensure performance, security, and reliability across virtual and physical infrastructure.

• Collaborate closely with network, security, and development teams to integrate automation solutions across the organization.

• Support industrialization efforts, migrations, and continuous improvement projects.

YOUR PROFILE

• Excellent command of Windows Server administration.

• Excellent command of PowerShell (scripting, modules, APIs, end to end automation).

• Good command of VMware Aria / vRealize Automation (vRA, vRO, blueprints, workflows). Knowledge of other Aria suite components is considered an asset.

• Knowledge of virtualization technologies (VMware vSphere).

• Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD applied to automation, REST APIs, and system integrations

• Experience with Azure, Terraform, GIT and Ansible is considered an asset.

• Strong problem-solving mindset and continuous improvement orientation.

• Ability to work independently in a complex environment.

• Strong service orientation and excellent communication skills.

• Analytical approach and rigorous documentation practices.

NB: Please be aware that in accordance with the current law and job requirements, the selected candidate will be requested to provide a criminal record (section 3).

jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

With more than 200 professionals, our Investment Solutions department is responsible for providing sophisticated and customised investment proposals to our private clients. In this context, we are seeking an experienced Investment Advisor to join our wealth management team in Geneva.

YOUR ROLE

• Actively manage, monitor and review advisory portfolios for South Europe and Latin America regions.

• Offer clients and bankers portfolio advisory services, in accordance to Lombard Odier’s view as well as clients’ constraints and preferences.

• Prepare and present in a compelling manner investment proposals, reports and presentations to clients and prospects.

• Contribute to the development of the investment offering and the client book through strong commercial support to bankers.

• Master the investment solutions offering of the bank, in order to advise the bankers and clients in the most adapted manner.

• Maintain a high degree of knowledge on financial markets, traditional and alternative assets, investment strategy and portfolio management as well as market trends, particularly in the regions of coverage.

• Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies.

YOUR PROFILE

• Bank or university education and/or recognised diploma in investment (CFA an asset).

• Minimum 10 years’ proven track record in advisory and/or portfolio management, ideally in the regions of coverage.

• Excellent customer presentation, client service and communication skills. Strong commercial awareness.

• Strong analytical and quantitative skills, flexibility and autonomy, ability to acquire and share skills.

• Team player, with ability to acquire and share skills, build trust and collaborate effectively with colleagues and clients.

• Open and dynamic personality with ability to take decisions, flexibility and autonomy.

• Ability to work efficiently under pressure and evolving market conditions.

• Good knowledge of Bloomberg, Excel and PowerPoint.

• Fluent in English and French. Spanish would be an asset.

• Swiss domicile.

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote a diverse and inclusive work environment for our employees and candidates. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are woven into the fabric of our Maison’s DNA, and we strive to ensure that our employees can fulfill both their personal and professional aspirations by encouraging internal mobility and individual upskilling programs. We firmly believe that building Diverse Teams contributes to our successes and to deliver on this, we actively embed Diversity, Equity and Inclusion in our business strategy.

It is an exciting time to join our Teams. All applications will be handled in the strictest

descriptionByLocale.it:
Una carriera a Lombard Odier significa lavorare per un rinomato asset manager globale, con un forte focus sugli investimenti sostenibili. Un'innovativa banca di scelta per clienti privati e istituzionali, il nostro Studio indipendente di proprietà è uno dei gruppi bancari più capitalizzati al mondo, che gestisce quasi 300 miliardi di franchi e opera da oltre 25 uffici in 4 continenti. Con una storia di oltre 230 anni, Lombard Odier è una casa di investimento che offre un'offerta completa di gestione del portafoglio discrezionale e consultivo, servizi di ricchezza e custodia. Offriamo anche servizi di asset management e strategie di investimento attraverso Lombard Odier Investment Manager e fornire tecnologia bancaria avanzata ad altre istituzioni finanziarie. “Rethink Everything” è la nostra filosofia – è al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo. Siamo cresciuti più forti attraverso più di 40 crisi finanziarie ripensando il mondo intorno a noi per fornire una nuova prospettiva di investimento per i nostri clienti. Con oltre 200 professionisti, il nostro reparto Investment Solutions è responsabile di fornire proposte di investimento sofisticate e personalizzate ai nostri clienti privati. In questo contesto, stiamo cercando un esperto Investment Advisor per unirsi al nostro team di gestione della ricchezza a Ginevra. Il tuo!
• Gestione attiva, monitoraggio e revisione dei portafogli di consulenza per le regioni del Sud Europa e dell'America Latina.
• Offrire ai clienti e ai banchieri servizi di consulenza di portafoglio, in conformità alla visione di Lombard Odier, nonché vincoli e preferenze dei clienti.
• Preparare e presentare in modo convincente proposte di investimento, relazioni e presentazioni a clienti e prospettive.
• Contribuire allo sviluppo dell'offerta di investimento e del libro clienti attraverso un forte supporto commerciale ai banchieri.
• Padroneggiare le soluzioni di investimento offerte dalla banca, al fine di consigliare i banchieri e i clienti nel modo più adeguato.
• Mantenere un elevato grado di conoscenza dei mercati finanziari, dei beni tradizionali e alternativi, della strategia di investimento e della gestione del portafoglio nonché delle tendenze del mercato, in particolare nelle regioni di copertura.
• Assicurare il rispetto dei requisiti normativi e delle politiche interne. Il tuo progetto
• Istruzione bancaria o universitaria e/o diploma riconosciuto in investimento (CFA un bene).
• Minimo record di tracciato di 10 anni in consulenza e/o gestione del portafoglio, idealmente nelle regioni di copertura.
• Ottima presentazione del cliente, servizio clienti e capacità di comunicazione. Forte consapevolezza commerciale.
• Forte capacità analitiche e quantitative, flessibilità e autonomia, capacità di acquisire e condividere competenze.
• Giocatore di squadra, con la capacità di acquisire e condividere competenze, costruire fiducia e collaborare efficacemente con colleghi e clienti.
• Personalità aperta e dinamica con capacità di prendere decisioni, flessibilità e autonomia.
• Capacità di lavorare in modo efficiente sotto pressione e condizioni di mercato in evoluzione.
• Buona conoscenza di Bloomberg, Excel e PowerPoint.
• Fluente in inglese e francese. Lo spagnolo sarebbe una risorsa.
• Domicilio svizzero. Il DNA della nostra Maison è definito da cinque valori fondamentali. L'eccellenza ci spinge ad essere i migliori a quello che facciamo, mentre l'innovazione alimenta i nostri progressi. Il rispetto sostiene ogni interazione, e l'integrità plasma le nostre azioni. Insieme, siamo un team unico, uniti nel servire i nostri clienti con dedizione inaspettata. Come datore di lavoro responsabile e di supporto, promuoviamo un ambiente di lavoro diversificato e inclusivo per i nostri dipendenti e candidati. Diversità, equità e inclusione sono intrecciati nel tessuto del DNA della nostra Maison, e ci sforziamo di garantire che i nostri dipendenti possano soddisfare sia le loro aspirazioni personali che professionali incoraggiando la mobilità interna e programmi di upskilling individuali. Crediamo fermamente che la costruzione di Diverse Teams contribuisca ai nostri successi e a fornire su questo, abbiamo attivamente incorporato Diversità, Equità e Inclusione nella nostra strategia aziendale. E' un momento emozionante per unirsi ai nostri team. Tutte le applicazioni saranno gestite nel più rigoroso

Eine Karriere bei Lombard Odier bedeutet, für einen renommierten globalen Vermögens- und Vermögensverwalter mit einem starken Fokus auf nachhaltige Investitionen zu arbeiten. Eine innovative Bank der Wahl für private und institutionelle Kunden, unser unabhängiger Eigentümer Firm ist eine der besten Bankengruppen der Welt, die in der Nähe von CHF 300 Milliarden verwaltet und von über 25 Büros auf 4 Kontinenten. Lombard Odier ist mit einer über 230-jährigen Geschichte ein Investmenthaus, das ein umfassendes Angebot an diskreten und beratenden Portfolio-Management, Vermögensdienstleistungen und Sorge bietet. Wir bieten auch Asset-Management-Dienste und Anlagestrategien durch Lombard Odier Investment Manager und bieten fortschrittliche Banktechnologie an andere Finanzinstitute. „Rethink Everything“ ist unsere Philosophie – es liegt im Herzen von allem, was wir tun. Wir sind durch mehr als 40 Finanzkrisen stärker gewachsen, indem wir die Welt um uns herum neu denken, um unseren Kunden eine neue Investitionsperspektive zu bieten. Mit mehr als 200 Fachleuten ist unsere Investment Solutions-Abteilung für anspruchsvolle und maßgeschneiderte Investitionsvorschläge für unsere Privatkunden verantwortlich. In diesem Zusammenhang suchen wir einen erfahrenen Investment Advisor, um unserem Vermögensverwaltungsteam in Genf beizutreten. IHRE ROLLE
• Aktive Verwaltung, Überwachung und Überprüfung von Beratungsportfolios für Regionen Südeuropas und Lateinamerikas.
• Angeboten Sie Kunden und Bankiers Portfolio Beratung, nach Lombard Odier Ansicht sowie Kunden Zwänge und Präferenzen.
• Bereiten und präsentieren auf überzeugende Weise Investitionsvorschläge, Berichte und Präsentationen an Kunden und Perspektiven.
• Beitrag zur Entwicklung des Anlageangebots und des Kundenbuchs durch starke kommerzielle Unterstützung an Banker.
• Beherrschen Sie die Anlagelösungen der Bank, um die Banker und Kunden in der am besten angepassten Weise zu beraten.
• Erhalten Sie ein hohes Maß an Kenntnissen auf den Finanzmärkten, traditionellen und alternativen Vermögenswerten, Anlagestrategien und Portfoliomanagement sowie Markttrends, insbesondere in den Bereichen der Deckung.
• Gewährleistung der Einhaltung regulatorischer Anforderungen und interner Richtlinien. IHRE PROFILE
• Bank- oder Hochschulbildung und/oder anerkanntes Diplom in Investitionen (CFA-Anteil).
• Mindestens 10 Jahre bewährte Erfolgsbilanz im Beratungs- und/oder Portfoliomanagement, ideal in den Bereichen der Deckung.
• Ausgezeichnete Kundenpräsentation, Kundendienst und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. Starkes kommerzielles Bewusstsein.
• Starke analytische und quantitative Fähigkeiten, Flexibilität und Autonomie, Fähigkeit, Fähigkeiten zu erwerben und zu teilen.
• Teamplayer, mit der Fähigkeit, Fähigkeiten zu erwerben und zu teilen, Vertrauen aufzubauen und effektiv mit Kollegen und Kunden zusammenarbeiten.
• Offene und dynamische Persönlichkeit mit Entscheidungsfähigkeit, Flexibilität und Autonomie.
• Fähigkeit, unter Druck effizient zu arbeiten und Marktbedingungen zu entwickeln.
• Gute Kenntnisse von Bloomberg, Excel und PowerPoint.
• Fluent auf Englisch und Französisch. Spanisch wäre ein Vermögenswert.
• Schweizer Domizil. Die DNA unseres Hauses wird durch fünf Kernwerte definiert. Exzellenz treibt uns dazu, das Beste zu sein, während Innovation unseren Fortschritt vorantreibt. Als verantwortungsbewusster und unterstützender Arbeitgeber fördern wir ein vielfältiges und inklusives Arbeitsumfeld für unsere Mitarbeiter und Kandidaten. Diversity, Equity und Inclusion sind in den Stoff unserer Maison’s DNA gewebt, und wir bemühen uns, sicherzustellen, dass unsere Mitarbeiter ihre persönlichen und beruflichen Bestrebungen erfüllen können, indem wir interne Mobilität und individuelle Upskilling-Programme fördern. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Une carrière chez Lombard Odier signifie travailler pour un gérant mondial de patrimoine et d'actifs renommé, avec un accent fort sur l'investissement durable. Banque innovante de choix pour les clients privés et institutionnels, notre entreprise indépendante est l'un des groupes bancaires les mieux capitalisés au monde, gérant près de CHF 300 milliards et opérant depuis plus de 25 bureaux sur 4 continents. Avec une histoire de plus de 230 ans, Lombard Odier est une maison d'investissement offrant une offre complète de gestion de portefeuille discrétionnaire et consultative, de services de patrimoine et de garde. Nous offrons également des services de gestion d'actifs et des stratégies d'investissement par l'intermédiaire de Lombard Odier Investment Managers et fournissons une technologie bancaire avancée à d'autres institutions financières. Repensez Tout est notre philosophie – elle est au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. Nous sommes devenus plus forts grâce à plus de 40 crises financières en repensant le monde qui nous entoure pour offrir une nouvelle perspective d'investissement à nos clients. Avec plus de 200 professionnels, notre service Solutions d'investissement est chargé de fournir des propositions d'investissement sophistiquées et personnalisées à nos clients privés. Dans ce contexte, nous cherchons un conseiller en investissement expérimenté pour rejoindre notre équipe de gestion de patrimoine à Genève. Votre rôle
• Gérer, surveiller et examiner activement les portefeuilles de conseils pour les régions d'Europe du Sud et d'Amérique latine.
• Offrir aux clients et aux banquiers des services de conseil de portefeuille, selon la vue de Lombard Odier, ainsi que les contraintes et les préférences des clients.
• Préparer et présenter de manière convaincante des propositions d'investissement, des rapports et des présentations aux clients et aux perspectives.
• Contribuer au développement de l'offre d'investissement et du livre client grâce à un solide soutien commercial aux banquiers.
• Maîtriser l'offre de solutions d'investissement de la banque, afin de conseiller les banquiers et les clients de la manière la plus adaptée.
• Maintenir un niveau élevé de connaissances sur les marchés financiers, les actifs traditionnels et alternatifs, la stratégie d'investissement et la gestion de portefeuille, ainsi que les tendances du marché, en particulier dans les régions couvertes.
• Assurer le respect des exigences réglementaires et des politiques internes. VOTRE PROFIL
• Formation bancaire ou universitaire et/ou diplôme reconnu en investissement (CFA un actif).
• Au moins 10 ans d'expérience en matière de conseil et/ou de gestion de portefeuille, idéalement dans les régions couvertes.
• Excellente présentation des clients, service à la clientèle et compétences en communication. Une forte sensibilisation commerciale.
• Fortes compétences analytiques et quantitatives, flexibilité et autonomie, capacité d'acquérir et de partager des compétences.
• Joueur d'équipe, capable d'acquérir et de partager des compétences, de renforcer la confiance et de collaborer efficacement avec ses collègues et ses clients.
• Personnalité ouverte et dynamique avec capacité de prendre des décisions, flexibilité et autonomie.
• Capacité de travailler efficacement sous pression et dans des conditions de marché en évolution.

jobs.title: International IT Services Specialist (80-100%)
jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

International IT Services Specialist (80-100%)

International IT Services Specialists are responsible for the IT onsite support to Lombard Odier users across local offices. Their duties include installing, maintaining, and repairing hardware and software components of the organization’s computer systems. They provide support both remotely and through on-site visits, depending on the needs of the teams. The role involves frequent collaboration with Infrastructure Teams at the Headquarters, and depending on the context, may also take on project management responsibilities.

YOUR ROLE

• Provide support for Microsoft technologies: Windows 11, Office 365, Teams

• Manage Mobile Device Management for iOS and Android

• Assist in managing and maintaining network infrastructure under Level 3 supervision and perform 2nd-level troubleshooting

• Maintain and update the network and system CMDB (NetBox)

• Manage and maintain systems infrastructure in collaboration with the Systems Team (ESX)

• Manage and maintain the printing infrastructure

• Install and configure laptops, desktops, servers, switches, and perform patching work

• Troubleshoot and replace laptops, desktops, and components

• Support Citrix environments (XenApp, XenDesktop)

• Maintain and update software and hardware inventory

• Assist in budget preparation, manage contracts, and negotiate with local vendors

• Oversee contractor installations and maintenance during office moves, shutdown and opening operations

• Advise users on hardware and software usage

• Provide support to the bank’s Independent Asset Managers in the region

• Create, update, and maintain documentation and internal wiki

• Participate in implementation and deployment of group projects

• Contribute to the Business Continuity Plan and act as a point of contact during BCP invocation

YOUR PROFILE

• Degree in Computer Science, engineering or relevant field mandatory

• +7-years proven experience in IT technical support and similar roles

• Excellent command in installing, maintaining and troubleshooting computers running Windows 11

• Excellent command of Office 365, Teams

• Excellent command of Apple and Android mobile devices

• Strong knowledge of the OSI model and Enterprise Network Infrastructure

• Knowledge in Project Management of IT Infrastructure Projects

• Relevant certification from advantage (MS-700, CCNA, ITIL…)

• Willingness to continuously learn and high interest in new technologies

• High readiness to get things done

• Very good organization skills and ability to work independently and to be a great team player

• Strong service orientation and excellent communication skills

• Fluent in French and English

• Flexible to travel to the offices in the EMEA Region (Travel Activity 20%)

NB: Please be aware that in accordance with the current law and job requirements, the selected candidate will be requested to provide a criminal record (section 3).

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Exc
