titleByLocale.it: Controllore degli Investimenti in Beni Privati (80-100%)

jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

To further strengthen our Private Assets department, we are looking for a Geneva based

Private Assets Investment Controller (80-100%)

In this role, you will contribute to the operational, financial, and analytical oversight of our Private Assets portfolios.

YOUR ROLE

• Ensure the administrative follow-up of Private Assets investment funds and mandates

• Collect, verify, and process subscription forms for new investments

• Prepare and release capital call and distribution notices

• Support the preparation of AUM and NNM reporting

• Participate in the production of track records and performance analytics

• Prepare the quarterly valuations of Private Assets investment funds

• Support product launches from an operational perspectives

• Participate in the preparation and issuance of client invoices

• Contribute to IT system enhancements through user acceptance testing and validation

• Coordinate with Fund Accountants to ensure accurate bookkeeping and data integrity

• Prepare regular reports and dashboards for Private Assets Investment Managers

• Support the preparation of updates for Senior Management and Boards

• Perform accounting and controlling activities for Private Assets products and mandates

• Support internal and external audit requests and provide active assistance to the team

• Liaise with departments across the Group, LOIM, and the Private Bank (e.g., Finance, Operations)

YOUR PROFILE

• Master’s degree, ideally in economics, finance, or a related discipline

• 3–5 years of experience in controlling within Private Assets

• Strong command of English (spoken and written) and good knowledge of French

• Excellent Excel skills; solid knowledge of eFront; exposure to Alteryx or Tableau is a plus

• Rigorous, detail‑oriented, and able to manage priorities and meet deadlines

• Strong team player with a collaborative mindset and excellent communication skills

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote a diverse and inclusive work environment for our employees and candidates. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are woven into the fabric of our Maison’s DNA, and we strive to ensure that our employees can fulfill both their personal and professional aspirations by encouraging internal mobility and individual upskilling programs. We firmly believe that building Diverse Teams contributes to our successes and to deliver on this, we actively embed Diversity, Equity and Inclusion in our business strategy.

It is an exciting time to join our Teams. All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Una carriera a Lombard Odier significa lavorare per un rinomato asset manager globale, con un forte focus sugli investimenti sostenibili. Un'innovativa banca di scelta per clienti privati e istituzionali, il nostro Studio indipendente di proprietà è uno dei gruppi bancari più capitalizzati al mondo, che gestisce quasi 300 miliardi di franchi e opera da oltre 25 uffici in 4 continenti. Con una storia di oltre 230 anni, Lombard Odier è una casa di investimento che offre un'offerta completa di gestione del portafoglio discrezionale e consultivo, servizi di ricchezza e custodia. Offriamo anche servizi di asset management e strategie di investimento attraverso Lombard Odier Investment Manager e fornire tecnologia bancaria avanzata ad altre istituzioni finanziarie. “Rethink Everything” è la nostra filosofia – è al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo. Siamo cresciuti più forti attraverso più di 40 crisi finanziarie ripensando il mondo intorno a noi per fornire una nuova prospettiva di investimento per i nostri clienti. Per rafforzare ulteriormente il nostro dipartimento di beni privati, stiamo cercando una base di Ginevra Private Assets Investment Controller (80-100%) In questo ruolo, contribuirai alla supervisione operativa, finanziaria e analitica dei nostri portafogli Private Assets. Il tuo!
• Assicurare il follow-up amministrativo dei fondi e dei mandati di investimento dei beni privati
• Raccogliere, verificare e elaborare moduli di abbonamento per nuovi investimenti
• Preparare e rilasciare comunicazioni di capitale e distribuzione
• Sostenere la preparazione di report AUM e NNM
• Partecipare alla produzione di track record e analisi delle prestazioni
• Preparare le valutazioni trimestrali dei fondi di investimento dei beni privati
• Lanci del prodotto di supporto da una prospettiva operativa
• Partecipare alla preparazione e all'emissione di fatture client
• Contribuire ai miglioramenti del sistema IT tramite test di accettazione dell'utente e validazione
• Coordinare con gli Accountants del Fondo per garantire la conservazione accurata e l'integrità dei dati
• Preparare report e dashboard regolari per i gestori privati degli investimenti
• Sostenere la preparazione degli aggiornamenti per la gestione senior e le schede
• Eseguire attività di contabilità e di controllo per i prodotti e i mandati di Private Assets
• Sostenere le richieste di audit interno ed esterno e fornire assistenza attiva al team
• Liaise con i dipartimenti di tutto il Gruppo, LOIM e la Banca Privata (ad esempio, Finanza, Operazioni) Il tuo progetto
• Laurea magistrale, idealmente in economia, finanza o disciplina correlata
• 3-5 anni di esperienza nel controllo dei beni privati
• Forte comando dell'inglese (spoken e scritto) e buona conoscenza del francese
• Eccellente abilità di Excel; solida conoscenza di eFront; l'esposizione ad Alteryx o Tableau è un plus
• Rigoroso, orientato ai dettagli e in grado di gestire le priorità e rispettare le scadenze
• Forte giocatore di squadra con una mentalità collaborativa e eccellenti capacità di comunicazione Il DNA della nostra Maison è definito da cinque valori fondamentali. L'eccellenza ci spinge ad essere i migliori a quello che facciamo, mentre l'innovazione alimenta i nostri progressi. Il rispetto sostiene ogni interazione, e l'integrità plasma le nostre azioni. Insieme, siamo un team unico, uniti nel servire i nostri clienti con dedizione inaspettata. Come datore di lavoro responsabile e di supporto, promuoviamo un ambiente di lavoro diversificato e inclusivo per i nostri dipendenti e candidati. Diversità, equità e inclusione sono intrecciati nel tessuto del DNA della nostra Maison, e ci sforziamo di garantire che i nostri dipendenti possano soddisfare sia le loro aspirazioni personali che professionali incoraggiando la mobilità interna e programmi di upskilling individuali. Crediamo fermamente che la costruzione di Diverse Teams contribuisca ai nostri successi e a fornire su questo, abbiamo attivamente incorporato Diversità, Equità e Inclusione nella nostra strategia aziendale. E' un momento emozionante per unirsi ai nostri team. Tutte le applicazioni saranno gestite nella massima fiducia.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Eine Karriere bei Lombard Odier bedeutet, für einen renommierten globalen Vermögens- und Vermögensverwalter mit einem starken Fokus auf nachhaltige Investitionen zu arbeiten. Eine innovative Bank der Wahl für private und institutionelle Kunden, unser unabhängiger Eigentümer Firm ist eine der besten Bankengruppen der Welt, die in der Nähe von CHF 300 Milliarden verwaltet und von über 25 Büros auf 4 Kontinenten. Lombard Odier ist mit einer über 230-jährigen Geschichte ein Investmenthaus, das ein umfassendes Angebot an diskreten und beratenden Portfolio-Management, Vermögensdienstleistungen und Sorge bietet. Wir bieten auch Asset-Management-Dienste und Anlagestrategien durch Lombard Odier Investment Manager und bieten fortschrittliche Banktechnologie an andere Finanzinstitute. „Rethink Everything“ ist unsere Philosophie – es liegt im Herzen von allem, was wir tun. Wir sind durch mehr als 40 Finanzkrisen stärker gewachsen, indem wir die Welt um uns herum neu denken, um unseren Kunden eine neue Investitionsperspektive zu bieten. Um unsere Private Assets-Abteilung weiter zu stärken, suchen wir nach einem Genfer Unternehmen Private Assets Investment Controller (80-100%) In dieser Funktion tragen Sie zur operativen, finanziellen und analytischen Aufsicht unserer Private Assets Portfolios bei. IHRE ROLLE
• Gewährleistung der administrativen Nachverfolgung von Private Assets Investmentfonds und Mandaten
• Formulare für neue Investitionen sammeln, überprüfen und bearbeiten
• Vorbereiten und Freigeben von Kapitalanrufen und Verteilungsankündigungen
• Unterstützung der Vorbereitung der AUM- und NNM-Berichterstattung
• Teilnahme an der Produktion von Track Records und Performance Analytics
• Vorbereiten der vierteljährlichen Bewertungen von Private Assets Investmentfonds
• Produktstarts aus operativer Perspektive unterstützen
• Teilnahme an der Vorbereitung und Ausgabe von Kundenrechnungen
• Nutzen Sie IT-Systemerweiterungen durch Anwenderakzeptanzprüfung und Validierung
• Koordinieren Sie mit den Buchhaltern des Fonds, um eine genaue Buchführung und Datenintegrität sicherzustellen

Avec une histoire de plus de 230 ans, Lombard Odier est une maison d'investissement offrant une offre complète de gestion de portefeuille discrétionnaire et consultative, de services de patrimoine et de garde. Votre rôle
• Assurer le suivi administratif des fonds et mandats d'investissement privés
• Recueillir, vérifier et traiter les formulaires de souscription pour les nouveaux investissements

• Appuyer la préparation de rapports sur l'AUM et la NNM
• Participer à la production d'enregistrements de piste et d'analyses de performance
• Préparer les évaluations trimestrielles des fonds d'investissement privés
• Soutenir les lancements de produits sous l'angle opérationnel
• Participer à la préparation et à la publication des factures des clients;
• Contribuer à l'amélioration des systèmes informatiques par des tests d'acceptation et de validation des utilisateurs
• Coordonner avec les experts-comptables pour assurer l'exactitude de la comptabilité et de l'intégrité des données

• Appuyer la préparation de mises à jour pour les cadres supérieurs et les conseils d'administration
• Exécuter des activités de comptabilité et de contrôle pour les produits et les mandats d'actifs privés
• Appuyer les demandes d'audit interne et externe et fournir une assistance active à l'équipe
• Assurer la liaison avec les départements du Groupe, de la LOIM et de la Banque privée (par exemple, Finances, Opérations) VOTRE PROFIL

• Forte maîtrise de l'anglais (parlé et écrit) et bonne connaissance du français
• Excellentes compétences Excel; solide connaissance de eFront; exposition à Alteryx ou Tableau est un plus
• Régulière, détaillée et capable de gérer les priorités et de respecter les délais
• Joueur d'équipe solide avec un esprit de collaboration et d'excellentes compétences en communication L'ADN de la Maison est défini par cinq valeurs fondamentales. jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Senior IT Production Engineer – Scheduling / File Transfer / Monitoring (80-100%)

As part of the modernization of our IT platform (renewal of our platforms), we are looking for production engineers familiar with technologies around file transfer, scheduling and alerting, who will be able to support us throughout this transformation, while at the same time supporting the current installed base.

Management of an application pool within the IT Operations department (Technologies and Operations unit), in a team of 7 employees operating from Geneva.

YOUR MISSION

• Responsible for implementing business requests on our alerting/scheduling/file transfer platforms

• Qualification of requests, detailed documentation of specs

• Actively participate and make proposals for the evolution of the platforms

• Actively participate and make proposals to improve and automate existing processes

• Level 2/3 support for existing workflows

Internal Contacts:

• Steering committee

• Production team (Product-Support)

• Integration team

• All technical teams (Data bases, System, Telecom, Citrix,)

• Development teams based in Geneva

• Support teams (Service Desk and Application Support)

• Service Management teams (Incidents and Problems)

External Contacts:

• Suppliers of external products and/or services

• Technical sponsors of certain banking infrastructure customers

• Technical sponsors of partners of our banking infrastructure customers

YOUR PROFILE

• Higher education in computer science (Master's degree or equivalent)

• 2 to 10 years in a similar position

• Significant experience on file transfer: implementation of industrial transfer protocols, certificate management. GoAnywhere would be a plus

• Scheduling: OpCon, Control-M or equivalent would be a plus

• Monitoring/alerting: Service Now Event Management, Nagios, SCOM, scripting (Powershell, shell) would be a plus

• Responsible, rigorous, versatile, flexible and with good interpersonal skills. Strong team spirit, desire for continuous improvement, proactive.

• Fluency in French and English (spoken and written)

• Residence in Switzerland or willing to relocate

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote a diverse and inclusive work environment for our employees and candidates. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are woven into the fabric of our Maison’s DNA, and we strive to ensure that our employees can fulfill both their personal and professional aspirations by encouraging internal mobility and individual upskilling programs. We firmly believe that building Diverse Teams contributes to our successes and to deliver on this, we actively embed Diversity, Equity and Inclusion in our business strategy.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Eine Karriere bei Lombard Odier bedeutet, für einen renommierten globalen Vermögens- und Vermögensverwalter mit einem starken Fokus auf nachhaltige Investitionen zu arbeiten. Eine innovative Bank der Wahl für private und institutionelle Kunden, unser unabhängiger Eigentümer Firm ist eine der besten Bankengruppen der Welt, die in der Nähe von CHF 300 Milliarden verwaltet und von über 25 Büros auf 4 Kontinenten. Lombard Odier ist mit einer über 230-jährigen Geschichte ein Investmenthaus, das ein umfassendes Angebot an diskreten und beratenden Portfolio-Management, Vermögensdienstleistungen und Sorge bietet. Wir bieten auch Asset-Management-Dienste und Anlagestrategien durch Lombard Odier Investment Manager und bieten fortschrittliche Banktechnologie an andere Finanzinstitute. „Rethink Everything“ ist unsere Philosophie – es liegt im Herzen von allem, was wir tun. Wir sind durch mehr als 40 Finanzkrisen stärker gewachsen, indem wir die Welt um uns herum neu denken, um unseren Kunden eine neue Investitionsperspektive zu bieten. Unsere Region Südeuropa & Lateinamerika (SELA) sucht einen Leiter Spaniens, um unsere Schweizer Teams zu leiten und zu entwickeln, die spanischen Kunden dienen. Diese strategische Führungsrolle bietet einen erheblichen Umfang, um das Unternehmen zu formen, Wachstum zu fördern und zu breiteren regionalen Initiativen in einem hochinternationalen Umfeld beizutragen. IHRE ROLLE
• Führen und entwickeln Sie die spanischen Teams mit Sitz in Genf und Zürich, um eine starke Leistung und Engagement in der Strategie der Bank sicherzustellen.
• Festlegung und Durchführung eines strategischen Geschäftsplans, einschließlich kommerzieller Initiativen, Marktpositionierung und Umsatzwachstum.
• Coach und entwickeln Private Bankers und gewinnen und halten Top-Talent.
• Führen Sie die Geschäftsentwicklung, einschließlich Team und individuelle Kennzahlen, Umsatzwachstum und Net New Money Generation.
• Gewährleistung von Exzellenz im Risikomanagement und Compliance und Einhaltung der höchsten Standards.
• Gesetz als Mitglied des SELA-Exekutivkomitees und trägt zur breiteren regionalen Strategie und Entscheidungsfindung bei.
• Stärkung der Marktintelligenz in Spanien und Identifizierung von Innovations- und Wachstumsmöglichkeiten.
• Gestalten und koordinieren Sie maßgeschneiderte Angebote und Initiativen für spanische Kunden an Standorten und regionalen Märkten IHRE PROFILE
• Mindestens 10 Jahre relevante Erfahrungen in der Bankenbranche.
• Bewährte Führungsfähigkeiten, mit Potenzial für größere Reichweite und Entwicklung. Fähigkeit, Teams zu inspirieren, zu entwickeln und zu skalieren.
• Starke kommerzielle Denkweise mit einer Spur von wachsenden Kundenbeziehungen und Einnahmen.
• Fähigkeit, persönliche Initiative, Eigentum, Verantwortlichkeit und Unternehmertum zu demonstrieren.
• Fähigkeit, talentierte und qualifizierte Fachkräfte zu gewinnen, zu rekrutieren und zu entwickeln.
• Strategischer Denker mit der Fähigkeit, sowohl Hand-on als auch auf einer breiteren Führungsebene zu betreiben.
• Fluent geschrieben und gesprochen Spanisch und Englisch, Französisch und andere relevante Sprachen ein Vermögen. Die DNA unseres Hauses wird durch fünf Kernwerte definiert. Exzellenz treibt uns dazu, das Beste zu sein, während Innovation unseren Fortschritt vorantreibt. Respekt unterstützt jede Interaktion und Integrität prägt unsere Handlungen. Gemeinsam sind wir ein Team, vereint in der Betreuung unserer Kunden mit unerschütterlicher Hingabe. Als verantwortungsbewusster und unterstützender Arbeitgeber fördern wir ein vielfältiges und inklusives Arbeitsumfeld für unsere Mitarbeiter und Kandidaten. Diversity, Equity und Inclusion sind in den Stoff unserer Maison’s DNA gewebt, und wir bemühen uns, sicherzustellen, dass unsere Mitarbeiter ihre persönlichen und beruflichen Bestrebungen erfüllen können, indem wir interne Mobilität und individuelle Upskilling-Programme fördern. Wir sind fest davon überzeugt, dass der Aufbau von Diverse Teams zu unseren Erfolgen beiträgt und dass wir darauf aktiv Diversity, Equity und Inclusion in unsere Geschäftsstrategie einbetten. Es ist eine aufregende Zeit, sich unseren Teams anzuschließen. Alle Anwendungen werden im strengsten Vertrauen behandelt.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Une carrière chez Lombard Odier signifie travailler pour un gérant mondial de patrimoine et d'actifs renommé, avec un accent fort sur l'investissement durable. Banque innovante de choix pour les clients privés et institutionnels, notre entreprise indépendante est l'un des groupes bancaires les mieux capitalisés au monde, gérant près de CHF 300 milliards et opérant depuis plus de 25 bureaux sur 4 continents. Avec une histoire de plus de 230 ans, Lombard Odier est une maison d'investissement offrant une offre complète de gestion de portefeuille discrétionnaire et consultative, de services de patrimoine et de garde. Nous offrons également des services de gestion d'actifs et des stratégies d'investissement par l'intermédiaire de Lombard Odier Investment Managers et fournissons une technologie bancaire avancée à d'autres institutions financières. Repensez Tout est notre philosophie – elle est au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. Nous sommes devenus plus forts grâce à plus de 40 crises financières en repensant le monde qui nous entoure pour offrir une nouvelle perspective d'investissement à nos clients. Notre région Europe du Sud et Amérique Latine (SELA) cherche un Chef d'Espagne pour diriger et développer nos équipes suisses au service de clients espagnols. Ce rôle de leadership stratégique offrira une marge de manoeuvre importante pour façonner l'entreprise, stimuler la croissance et contribuer à des initiatives régionales plus vastes dans un environnement international très élevé. Votre rôle
• Diriger et développer les équipes espagnoles basées à Genève et Zurich, en assurant une forte performance et un engagement au sein de la stratégie de la banque.
• Définir et exécuter un plan d'affaires stratégique comprenant des initiatives commerciales, le positionnement du marché et la croissance des recettes.
• Coach et développer des banquiers privés tout en attirant et en conservant les meilleurs talents.
• Diriger la performance des entreprises, y compris l'équipe et les KPI individuels, la croissance des revenus, et la génération nette de nouveaux fonds.
• Assurer l'excellence dans la gestion des risques et la conformité, en maintenant les normes les plus élevées.
• Agir en tant que membre du Comité exécutif du SELA, contribuant ainsi à une stratégie régionale plus large et à la prise de décisions.
• Renforcer l'information commerciale sur l'Espagne et identifier les possibilités d'innovation et de croissance.
• Concevoir et coordonner des offres et des initiatives sur mesure pour les clients espagnols à travers les sites et les marchés régionaux VOTRE PROFIL
• Au moins 10 ans d'expérience pertinente dans le secteur bancaire.
• Des capacités de leadership éprouvées, avec un potentiel d'élargissement et d'évolution. Capacité d'inspirer, de développer et d'améliorer les équipes.
• L'esprit commercial fort avec un record de relations avec les clients et de revenus croissants.
• Capacité de démontrer l'initiative personnelle, la propriété, la responsabilité et l'esprit d'entreprise.
• Capacité d'attirer, de recruter et de développer des professionnels talentueux et qualifiés.
• Un penseur stratégique ayant la capacité d'opérer à la fois sur le terrain et à un niveau de leadership plus large.
• L'espagnol et l'anglais, le français et d'autres langues pertinentes sont un atout. L'ADN de la Maison est défini par cinq valeurs fondamentales. L'excellence nous pousse à être les meilleurs dans ce que nous faisons, tandis que l'innovation alimente nos progrès. Le respect sous-tend chaque interaction, et l'intégrité façonne nos actions. Ensemble, nous sommes une équipe, unie pour servir nos clients avec un dévouement inébranlable. En tant qu'employeur responsable et solidaire, nous favorisons un milieu de travail diversifié et inclusif pour nos employés et nos candidats. Diversité, équité et inclusion sont tissés dans le tissu de notre ADN Maison, et nous nous efforçons de faire en sorte que nos employés puissent réaliser leurs aspirations personnelles et professionnelles en encourageant la mobilité interne et les programmes de perfectionnement individuel. Nous croyons fermement que la création d'équipes diversifiées contribue à nos succès et pour y parvenir, nous intégrons activement la diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion dans notre stratégie d'affaires. C'est un moment passionnant de rejoindre nos équipes. Toutes les demandes seront traitées avec la plus grande confiance.

jobs.title: Internship – Operations Support Specialist
jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Internship – Operations Support Specialist

As a member of our Operations team in Luxembourg, you will discover various Middle Office / Operations activities and learn how much they are central and critical to our Maison, worldwide. You will be an all-rounder and work with our main Operations teams, such as:

• Security Master File: Opening and updating information in the Security Masterfile database on financial instruments held by our clients.

• Income: Payment of dividends, coupons and redemptions on behalf of our clients for all markets and all types of financial instruments, including structured products and derivatives

• Reconciliation: Reconcile cash, securities, listed derivatives, precious metals, etc. Comparing transactions and balances of the Bank’s books with our network of cash counterparties, securities depositories, Transfer Agents etc.

• Operational Taxes: Preparation of tax calculations and statements for Europe- based retail clients and enterprises.

YOUR ROLE

• Assist team members in daily tasks

• Work on specific project and requests, while learning from senior peers

YOUR PROFILE

• A keen interest in the Banking sector, especially in Middle Office / Operations domains

• Collaborative team player with the ability to work independently

• Motivated, detail-oriented, proactive, able to multi-task

• Fluent in French, basic English proficiency

NB: Please be aware that in accordance with the current law and job requirements, the selected candidate will be requested to provide a criminal record (section 3).

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote a diverse and inclusive work environment for our employees and candidates. We firmly believe that building Diverse Teams contributes to our successes and to deliver on this, we actively embed Diversity, Equity and Inclusion in our business strategy.

It is an exciting time to join our Teams. All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence.

Senior Trust Relationship Manager (80-100%)
Private Clients – Wealth Planning

Lombard Odier Trust (Bermuda) Limited is seeking a Senior Trust Relationship Manager (STRM) to oversee a portfolio of international private client structures. This role combines client relationship management, trust administration oversight, and team coordination within a multicultural environment, ensuring high fiduciary, regulatory, and governance standards.

YOUR ROLE

Client Relationship & Trust Administration

• Act as primary contact for a portfolio of international private client structures.

• Manage relationships with clients, advisors, family offices, and internal stakeholders across jurisdictions.

• Oversee daily administration activities (distributions, transactions, resolutions, bank relationships, reviews, regulatory reporting such as CRS/FATCA).

• Review financial statements, maintain accurate records, and monitor client billing.

• Support business development, onboarding, and risk assessment processes.

Governance & Operations

• Contribute to reporting, audits, risk monitoring, and fiduciary strategy.

• Maintain and enhance policies, procedures, and internal controls.

• Monitor KPIs, fee governance, and operational efficiency improvements.

• Collaborate with stakeholders and represent the business in committees and industry forums.

Senior & Team Responsibilities

• Provide technical guidance and oversight on complex trust matters.

• Support work allocation, team coordination, and service delivery quality.

• Identify and manage operational and fiduciary risks.

• Mentor team members and promote best practices, strong compliance culture, and consistent service standards.

YOUR PROFILE

• TEP qualification (or equivalent) with 10+ years’ experience in trust administration or fiduciary services.

• Strong exposure to UHNW private clients and private banking environment.

• Proven ability to manage complex international client relationships with diplomacy and sound judgment.

• Solid understanding of fiduciary structures, risk management, and regulatory frameworks.

• Strong organisational, communication, and commercial skills.

• Fluent in English.

• French proficiency

• Wealth/tax planning or corporate secretary experience

• Knowledge of Viewpoint or similar systems

• Exposure to audit, compliance, or governance committees

• Experience in process improvement or transformation initiatives

• Strong cultural awareness and international exposure

• Expertise in governance, dispute resolution, or presentation of complex topics

jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

IT Security Engineer (80-100%)

The Security Engineer designs, implements and manages security solutions, ensuring an effective defense against cyber threats or data theft. Responsibilities include threat detection, vulnerability analysis, handling support tickets, and implementing security controls and related solutions (data leakage prevention, vulnerability management, security hardening, public key infrastructure, secrets management, privileged access management and endpoint security). The security engineer will also educate staff on best practices.

YOUR ROLE

• Design, implement, and maintain security solutions

• Conduct and/or contribute to security projects

• Assess and improve the security hardening of enterprise solutions

• Participate in alert and incident response reviews and propose improvement actions

• Propose new security solutions and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives

• Develop security workflows and automate recurring tasks

• Maintain comprehensive documentation of system configurations, procedures, incident reports, security requirements

• Contribute to enforcing robust security tools and secure coding practices in development

YOUR PROFILE

• Bachelor’s degree computer engineering, security engineering or a relevant field. Master degree is an engineering school is a plus

• Sound experience of Data Loss Prevention (DLP) solutions and best practices

• Strong interest in IT security, continuous learning, secure engineering practices and threat modeling, IT market trends

• Strong knowledge of Azure cloud, Microsoft 365 services and hybrid cloud services

• Excellent command of automation, scripting, Infrastructure‑as‑Code (IaC) principles, common software architecture patterns, networking protocols and technologies

• Highly analytical and rigorous, with a solution‑oriented mindset and strong autonomy

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate with both technical and non‑technical stakeholders

• Highly versatile and able to adapt to diverse technical contexts

• Fluency in English and French

• Residence in Switzerland or willingness to relocate

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

Una carriera a Lombard Odier significa lavorare per un rinomato asset manager globale, con un forte focus sugli investimenti sostenibili. Un'innovativa banca di scelta per clienti privati e istituzionali, il nostro Studio indipendente di proprietà è uno dei gruppi bancari più capitalizzati al mondo, che gestisce quasi 300 miliardi di franchi e opera da oltre 25 uffici in 4 continenti. Con una storia di oltre 230 anni, Lombard Odier è una casa di investimento che offre un'offerta completa di gestione del portafoglio discrezionale e consultivo, servizi di ricchezza e custodia. Offriamo anche servizi di asset management e strategie di investimento attraverso Lombard Odier Investment Manager e fornire tecnologia bancaria avanzata ad altre istituzioni finanziarie. “Rethink Everything” è la nostra filosofia – è al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo. Siamo cresciuti più forti attraverso più di 40 crisi finanziarie ripensando il mondo intorno a noi per fornire una nuova prospettiva di investimento per i nostri clienti. IT Security Engineer (80-100%) Il Security Engineer progetta, implementa e gestisce soluzioni di sicurezza, garantendo una difesa efficace contro le minacce informatiche o il furto di dati. Le responsabilità includono il rilevamento delle minacce, l'analisi delle vulnerabilità, la gestione dei biglietti di supporto, l'implementazione dei controlli di sicurezza e delle relative soluzioni (prevenzione delle perdite di dati, gestione delle vulnerabilità, indurimento della sicurezza, infrastruttura chiave pubblica, gestione dei segreti, gestione privilegiata dell'accesso e sicurezza endpoint). L'ingegnere della sicurezza educa anche il personale sulle migliori pratiche. Il tuo!
• Progettazione, realizzazione e manutenzione di soluzioni di sicurezza
• Condurre e/o contribuire a progetti di sicurezza
• Valutare e migliorare l'indurimento della sicurezza delle soluzioni aziendali
• Partecipare a recensioni di risposta all'avviso e agli incidenti e proporre azioni di miglioramento
• Proporre nuove soluzioni di sicurezza e contribuire a iniziative di miglioramento continuo
• Sviluppare flussi di lavoro di sicurezza e automatizzare le attività ricorrenti
• Mantenere la documentazione completa delle configurazioni del sistema, delle procedure, dei rapporti incidenti, dei requisiti di sicurezza
• Contribuire a rafforzare robusti strumenti di sicurezza e a garantire pratiche di codifica nello sviluppo Il tuo progetto
• Laurea di ingegneria informatica, ingegneria della sicurezza o un campo rilevante. Laurea magistrale è una scuola di ingegneria
• Esperienza sonora delle soluzioni e delle best practice di Data Loss Prevention (DLP)
• Forte interesse per la sicurezza informatica, l'apprendimento continuo, le pratiche ingegneristiche sicure e la modellazione delle minacce, le tendenze del mercato IT
• Forte conoscenza di cloud Azure, servizi Microsoft 365 e servizi cloud ibridi
• Comando eccellente dei principi di automazione, scripting, Infrastructure‐as‐Code (IaC), modelli di architettura software comune, protocolli di rete e tecnologie
• Altamente analitico e rigoroso, con una mentalità orientata alla soluzione e una forte autonomia
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale, con la capacità di comunicare con gli stakeholder tecnici e non tecnici
• Altamente versatile e in grado di adattarsi a diversi contesti tecnici
• Fluency in inglese e francese
• Residence in Svizzera o disponibilità a trasferirsi Il DNA della nostra Maison è definito da cinque valori fondamentali. L'eccellenza ci spinge ad essere i migliori a quello che facciamo, mentre l'innovazione alimenta i nostri progressi. Il rispetto sostiene ogni interazione, e l'integrità plasma le nostre azioni. Insieme, siamo un team unico, uniti nel servire i nostri clienti con dedizione inaspettata. Come datore di lavoro responsabile e di supporto, promuoviamo un ambiente di lavoro diversificato e inclusivo per i nostri dipendenti e candidati. Diversità, equità e inclusione sono intrecciati nel tessuto del DNA della nostra Maison, e ci sforziamo di garantire che i nostri dipendenti possano soddisfare sia le loro aspirazioni personali che professionali incoraggiando la mobilità interna e programmi di upskilling individuali. Crediamo fermamente che la costruzione di Diverse Teams contribuisca ai nostri successi e a fornire su questo, abbiamo attivamente incorporato Diversità, Equità e inclusione nel nostro business

jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Group Risk Assurance Controls Manager (80–100%)

We are seeking an experienced, proactive, and strategic Risk Assurance Controls Manager to join the Operational Risk Management department in Switzerland. This role sits within the second line of defense and carries full ownership of the Group’s risk assurance and control testing framework, including the design, execution, and continuous enhancement of assurance plans.
The successful candidate will lead and develop control testing activities across the organization, provide independent oversight over first line risk and control frameworks, and deliver high-impact insights to senior management and governance bodies. The role includes direct line management responsibility and requires a strong ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.

YOUR ROLE
Leadership & Ownership

• Own, design, and continuously enhance the Group-wide risk assurance control testing framework and annual assurance plan

• Lead and develop a small team (1 FTE), providing coaching, priority setting, and performance oversight

• Act as a subject matter expert and key point of contact for control assurance topics across the organization

• Drive consistency, quality, and efficiency in control testing methodologies and outputs

Control Testing Strategy & Execution

• Define, implement, and execute a risk-based control testing strategy aligned with regulatory expectations and internal priorities

• Oversee and perform periodic and ad-hoc control testing across business units and processes

• Ensure comprehensive coverage of key risks and controls, with a forward-looking and thematic approach

• Challenge the design and operating effectiveness of controls, identifying systemic weaknesses and emerging risks

• Ensure high-quality documentation of testing procedures, results, and conclusions

Second Line of Defense Oversight

• Provide independent oversight and challenge of first line risk management and control frameworks

• Assess the adequacy of Risk & Control Self-Assessments (RCSAs) and other first line control activities

• Engage with senior stakeholders to provide expert opinions on control effectiveness and risk exposure

• Collaborate with Internal Audit and other assurance functions to ensure alignment and avoid duplication

Reporting & Stakeholder Engagement

• Deliver clear, concise, and impactful reporting to senior management, risk committees, and governing bodies

• Escalate key issues, trends, and systemic control weaknesses in a timely manner

• Provide actionable recommendations to strengthen the control environment and mitigate risks

• Act as a trusted advisor to business and control functions on control design and assurance matters

Issue Management & Follow-up

• Oversee the tracking and validation of remediation actions for identified control deficiencies

• Ensure timely closure of issues and appropriate root cause analysis

• Monitor recurring themes and drive improvements at a structural level

•
Continuous Impro

Gestione dei controlli di sicurezza dei rischi di gruppo (80-100%) Siamo alla ricerca di un esperto, proattivo e strategico Risk Assurance Controls Manager per aderire al reparto Gestione del rischio operativo in Svizzera. Questo ruolo si trova all’interno della seconda linea di difesa e possiede la piena proprietà del quadro di test di sicurezza e controllo del Gruppo, tra cui la progettazione, l’esecuzione e il continuo miglioramento dei piani di garanzia. Il candidato di successo porterà e svilupperà attività di test di controllo in tutta l'organizzazione, fornire una supervisione indipendente sui quadri di rischio e controllo di prima linea, e fornire intuizioni ad alto impatto agli enti di gestione e di governance senior. Il ruolo include la responsabilità della gestione diretta della linea e richiede una forte capacità di influenzare gli stakeholder a tutti i livelli. Il tuo! Leadership e proprietà
• Possedere, progettare e migliorare continuamente il quadro di test di controllo dell’assicurazione del rischio a livello di Gruppo e il piano di garanzia annuale
• Guidare e sviluppare una piccola squadra (1 FTE), fornendo coaching, impostazione prioritaria e supervisione delle prestazioni
• Agire come esperto di materia e punto di contatto chiave per i temi di controllo dell'assicurazione in tutta l'organizzazione
• Consistenza dell'azionamento, qualità ed efficienza nelle metodologie e uscite di test di controllo Controllo Test di strategia e esecuzione
• Definire, implementare ed eseguire una strategia di controllo basata sui rischi allineata alle aspettative normative e alle priorità interne
• supervisionare ed eseguire test periodici e ad-hoc di controllo su unità aziendali e processi
• Assicurare una copertura completa di rischi e controlli chiave, con un approccio avanzato e tematico
• Sfidare la progettazione e l'efficacia operativa dei controlli, identificare le debolezze sistemiche e i rischi emergenti
• Assicurare la documentazione di alta qualità delle procedure di prova, dei risultati e delle conclusioni Seconda linea di difesa
• Fornire la supervisione indipendente e la sfida dei quadri di gestione e controllo del rischio di prima linea
• Valutare l'adeguatezza delle attività di Risk & Control Self-Assessments (RCSA) e altre attività di controllo della prima linea
• Impegnarsi con gli stakeholder senior per fornire opinioni di esperti sull'efficacia del controllo e sull'esposizione al rischio
• Collaborare con Audit interno e altre funzioni di garanzia per garantire l'allineamento ed evitare duplicazioni Reporting & Stakeholder Engagement
• Fornire rapporti chiari, concisi e d'impatto a dirigenti senior, comitati di rischio e organi di governo
• Escalare le questioni chiave, le tendenze e le debolezze di controllo sistemico in modo tempestivo
• fornire raccomandazioni attuabili per rafforzare l'ambiente di controllo e mitigare i rischi
• Agire come consulente affidabile per le funzioni aziendali e di controllo su questioni di progettazione e garanzia di controllo Gestione dei problemi & follow-up
• supervisionare il monitoraggio e la convalida delle azioni di bonifica per le carenze di controllo identificate
• Assicurare la chiusura tempestiva dei problemi e l'analisi delle cause radice appropriata
• Monitorare i temi ricorrenti e migliorare a livello strutturale
• Impronte continuo

jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Human Resources Business Partner – Technology & Operations & Central Functions (80-100%)

Lombard Odier is looking for an HR Business Partner to support its Technology & Operations & Central Function teams based in Switzerland. As a strategic HR business partner, you are the primary HR Partner for your Business Unit. You co-design HR strategy, anticipate organizational transformations and drive change in direct alignment with Business strategy.

YOUR ROLE

Strategic Partnership

• Develop a deep understanding of the BU’s business priorities

• Advise and challenge senior managers and leadership on organizational decisions, talent strategy, and performance

• Actively contribute to leadership committees and discussions on the evolution of the operating model

• Handle sensitive employee relations cases (harassment, misconduct, grievances, dismissal)

• Be a key point of contact for all employees to offer advice on career development, performance management, resolving conflicts

Change Management

• Identify and anticipate the human impact of transformations (restructuring, cultural shifts, digitalization)

• Design and lead change management plans: communication, capability building, and stakeholder engagement

• Ensure employee buy-in and sustained engagement throughout transition phases

• Measure change effectiveness and continuously adjust approach based on feedback and data

• Organizational Development & Talent

Lead talent review with the Business Unit

• Coach and support managers in strengthening their leadership capabilities

• Identify capability gaps and co-build tailored development plans

• Work closely with our Learning & Development team to identify training/coaching needs for business units

HR Operational Excellence

• Ensure quality and consistency of HR processes within the BU (Talent review, performance review & Objectif setting, yearly compensation review)

• Maintain social compliance and a healthy work environment (labor relations, psychosocial risk prevention)

• Leverage HR data and analytics to produce actionable insights for the business

YOUR PROFILE

• Proven experience (3+ years) as an HR Business Partner in a demanding environment

• Ability to read business environment and think in terms of organizational impact

• Advisory posture: assertiveness, courage and willingness to challenge status quo

• Strong facilitation, influencing and communication skills across all levels

• Results-oriented with a strong sense of priorities

• Comfortable with ambiguity

• Fluency in French and English (spoken and written)

• Residence in Switzerland or willingness to relocate.
